Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do

  • Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
  • Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
  • Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
  • AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

What We Look For

  • 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
  • Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
  • Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
  • Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.

Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

This team sits at the heart of Prime Video's licensing business and has ownership/insights across all of Prime Video's business lines (SVOD, TVOD, AVOD, etc) and all territories. You will be joining a team with high visibility to Prime Video leadership and high impact to the business.

Basic Qualifications


Experience with SQL
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements


Preferred Qualifications


5+ years of account management, business development, content licensing or finance experience

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact
Propose, monitor, and contextualize experiment design and execution to drive optimizations of Affirm’s GTM efforts, empirically quantify the value of Affirm to our prospective merchants, and upsell enhanced offers to existing merchants


What We Look For


5+ years of experience in an analytically-driven role (consulting, finance, analytics, etc.)
Strong working knowledge of SQL, data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Looker, Tableau). Understanding or a demonstrated aptitude to learn Python is a plus
Demonstrated aptitude in leveraging AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Exceptional problem-solving skills, including ability to operate in ambiguity and establishing analytical frameworks to apply to business problems
Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations, such as aligning stakeholders, or choosing the most impactful data to drive decisions
Ability to communicate effectively, and craft compelling narratives to influence business and technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization, internally and externally
Strong organization and execution skills, including ability to operate independently and drive multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously to drive business goals
Prior track record in building successful cross-functional relationships with partners internally and externally
Self-starter and a track record of successfully driving projects from end to end (from building strategy to implementation)
Passion and drive to disrupt both the retail and lending industry for the better
Enough laziness to find a faster way to do your least favorite tasks
Humility and a team player - you go out of your way to help teammates


Nice to Have


Knowledge of the FinTech or Payments industry
Prior experience performing data analytics for marketplace platforms
Demonstrated aptitude in AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)


Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 8

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $185,000 - $245,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $164,000 - $224,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Description:
Description

Do you share a passion to make customers successful? Do you believe that a deep understanding of customer and business priorities can transform an organization? Are you excited to discover and solve thorny business challenges through data analytics and business intelligence (BI) solutions? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment working with diverse teams cutting across functions, organizations, and cultures to achieve a common goal?

The Private Pricing Analytics and Insights team is a critical part of enabling the AWS Private Pricing business to achieve the highest standards of excellence for WW Commercial Operations. This role will focus on Business Analytics and Business Intelligence related to Private Pricing Deals, requiring broad technical skills, strong business acumen and a deep analytical background to provide performance reporting, actionable insights and decision support. In this role, you will partner with Private Pricing leaders and teams by leveraging your analytical expertise to transform business requirements into actionable solutions. You'll develop a deep understanding of the AWS Private Pricing business to drive insights that are relevant and actionable. Your responsibilities will include building analytical and forecasting models, creating intuitive self-service dashboards and visualizations, and implementing automation solutions that drive process improvements across the organization.

The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across other geographies. Successful members of this team collaborate effectively to solve data problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high operational standards. The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated individual that seeks to “tell the story” of the data with little direction or supervision against questions with a high degree of ambiguity.

Key job responsibilities


Lead business discussions to share insights, challenge status quo, and provide forward looking recommendations to enable strategic decision making and growth of Private Pricing.
Support the development of continuously-evolving business analytics and data models, own the quantitative analysis of the performance of our sales team, customers, deal team, partners, markets, and products/services.
Develop a deep understanding of sales metrics, reporting tools, and data structures in order to identify and drive resolution of issues, provide actionable intelligence with existing metrics or identify, develop, and propose new metrics, dashboards, scorecards or new tools.
Develop relationships and processes with sales, finance, sales operations, and other functional teams to identify and address reporting issues.
Manage and develop analytical tools or reports that through the automation existing inspection mechanisms such as business reviews, annual planning, and forecasting processes.
Create operational templates and processes to compile and standardize disparate information that drive standardized reporting and metrics tracking.
Generate ad-hoc analysis and reports with actionable recommendations based on the needs of the stakeholders, through ad-hoc data retrieval and analysis from data management systems,
Create new mechanisms and business processes that simplifies, standardizes and enables operational excellence.


About The Team

The Private Pricing team is instrumental in driving deal strategy, structuring, negotiations, and execution of private deals. Private Pricing deals consist of large, strategic, or highly competitive commercial deals.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results

Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience building data products incrementally and integrating and managing data sets from multiple sources
Experience using data and metrics to drive actionable insights at scale

At Leviton, we build what's next to light, power, and connect everyday spaces, from electrical to lighting, to data networks, and energy management. The Supply Chain Analyst II is responsible for independently applying analytical, reporting, and continuous-improvement methods to improve Supply Chain and Manufacturing performance. Independently perform data mining, data modeling, statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis, root-cause analysis, and scenario modeling to support supply chain and manufacturing decisions.

Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports, data preparation, workflows, and manual analytical processes.

Provide analytical support for supply chain and manufacturing projects, continuous-improvement initiatives, and management priorities.

Technical


Demonstrated experience independently analyzing business problems and translating results into practical recommendations required
Experience in creating and maintaining dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and management reporting required.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data modeling, advanced formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analytical reporting.
Proficiency in Power BI, including data preparation, data modeling, dashboard development, visualization, and report maintenance.
Proficiency with SQL, including queries, joins, aggregations, data validation, and the interpretation of relational datasets.
Ability to conduct root-cause analysis, scenario analysis, cost-benefit analysis, and quantitative business analysis.
Ability to convert complex data into clear findings, business implications, and actionable recommendations.
Experience working in a LEAN manufacturing or technology-manufacturing environment is preferred.


Behavioral


Communication - Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with coworkers, along with internal and external customers and key stakeholders
Problem-Solver - Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues and develop effective solutions
Attention to Detail - Ensure accuracy in work product, documentation, and processes to maintain high standards
Analytical Skills - Analyze data to make informed decisions
Critical Thinking - Ability to think critically and make informed decisions to optimize performance
Research Skills - Ability to conduct thorough research to create well-informed and credible content and decisions


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree required (preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations Management)
Professional certifications such as ASCM CPIM, CSCP, CLTD, Lean Six Sigma, Microsoft Power BI, or similar credentials are preferred.
Minimum three years of progressively responsible experience in supply chain, manufacturing, or business analytics

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.

The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
  • Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
  • Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
  • Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
  • Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
  • Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
  • Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
  • Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
  • Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
  • Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.

Title: Senior Commercial Business Analyst
Description:
SSA Marine is a Seattle-based global operator of marine terminals and stevedoring services, specializing in the movement and handling of cargo across major ports worldwide. As part of Carrix, the company manages container, bulk, and breakbulk operations, as well as intermodal and rail logistics that connect port activity to inland transportation networks. SSA Marine supports the efficient flow of goods across global supply chains, working with shipping lines, ports, and logistics partners to move a wide range of cargo, including containers, automobiles, and industrial materials.




Compensation Range: $95,000-120,000 per year + bonus. The posted compensation range is based on the applicable geographic market for the position and may vary depending on factors such as related experience and skill set. Final compensation will be determined based on these items and other relevant factors.




Location: Hybrid role based out of the corporate office in Seattle, WA (Harbor Island). You must already be local to the Seattle Area.







Summary/Objective:




The Senior Business Analyst, Commercial is a senior analytical role within SSA Marine’s evolving commercial capability and the dedicated owner of the Contracting, Customer Relationship Management & Analytics strategy; Commercial Insights, Analytics & Data Governance. The position exists to create enterprise visibility into commercial performance through governed reporting, analytics, benchmarking, and data stewardship.




Operating at the intersection of Commercial, Finance, Operations, and IT, the Sr. Business Analyst translates operational, contractual, customer, and market data into clear, decision-useful insight that supports pricing, contracting, customer governance, and budget planning across the container portfolio. The role moves the Division from manual, fragmented reporting toward a governed, self-service analytics environment featuring compelling visualization and, over time, predictive insight. Working closely with the Sr. Director and commercial peers, the role sets reporting standards, owns the Power BI inventory and self-service roadmap, sustains commercial data quality, and represents the Container Division in commercial data governance — enabling disciplined, data-driven commercial execution in support of the Division’s EBITDA North Star.




Essential Responsibilities:




Commercial Performance Reporting & Executive Insights

Own recurring monthly commercial performance reporting spanning volume, revenue, EBITDA, pricing, customer, terminal, and variance themes.
Translate reporting outputs into executive-ready narratives — what changed, what is driving it, what it means, and recommended actions — moving from pull reporting to a governed monthly push-insight cadence.
Complete ad hoc analyses to support negotiations, renewals, pricing, and strategic decisions on demand.

Benchmarking & Comparative Performance

Design and maintain a standard benchmarking framework comparing performance across terminals, customers, carriers, and key operating metrics.
Deliver quarterly comparative analyses that surface margin gaps, pricing opportunities, and best practices, converting findings into recommendations that inform pricing, contract strategy, and revenue optimization.

Governed Reporting Ecosystem & Self-Service Analytics

Build and maintain the commercial reporting catalog and Power BI inventory, establishing ownership, standards, and version control, and reducing duplication by retiring redundant legacy reports.
Develop and advance the enterprise self-service analytics roadmap — standardized, reusable dashboards, compelling visualization, and progression toward predictive insight.

Commercial Data Governance & Stewardship

Define and document critical commercial data elements and standard definitions; centralize commercial information to achieve a single source of truth and maintain an active data stewardship model.
Support data compilation, master data techniques, and control activities; safeguard data quality across contract, customer, operational, and financial datasets.
Support data quality and requirements for Ironclad, the Business Rating Engine (BRE), CRM, and enterprise reporting; represent the Container Division in enterprise data governance forums and the Data Leads Council.

Commercial Data Journey Ownership

Own the Commercial Data Journey, advancing the Division along the Commercial Intelligence Maturity Path: (1) Expand Visibility across all terminals; (2) create a Single Commercial Information Environment; (3) Standardize & Govern data definitions and metrics; (4) Enable Commercial Intelligence supporting pricing, customer governance, strategic account planning, and enterprise decision-making.

Tools, Enablement & Cross-Functional Decision Support

Serve as power user and business owner of commercial dashboards, reporting tools, and data models (e.g., Power BI); drive automation and standardization and partner with IT and Finance to improve data accessibility.
Determine resource requirements and costs to optimize commercial reporting processes and systems; build and validate business cases for reporting and analytics investments.
Act as a connective analytical partner across Commercial, Finance, Operations, and IT; provide structured analysis for budget planning, pricing, and strategy; and mentor intern and junior analytical talent to sustain the SSA talent pipeline.

Adoption, Change Management & Enablement

Lead adoption and change management for new reporting standards, governed dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities across the commercial teams.
Train and coach commercial users on self-service dashboards, reporting standards, and data definitions using both formal and informal methods; gather feedback to drive continuous improvement.
Other duties as assigned.




Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in commercial, financial, or data analysis, including delivery of recurring management reporting.
Strong data structuring capability — proven ability to organize, model, and standardize disparate, fragmented data into clean, reliable, decision-ready structures.
Demonstrated analytical prowess — rigorous, hypothesis-driven analysis that turns complex data into clear insight and recommendations.
Strong data visualization acumen — hands-on mastery of Power BI (and Excel) to build compelling, intuitive, executive-ready visuals and dashboards.
Strong communication and systems-thinking skills; ability to lead reporting standards and data governance through influence. Fluency in English (written and verbal).
Ability to travel (less than 10%) to customer sites, industry events, and SSA Marine locations may be required.




Preferred Qualifications:

6–8+ years of relevant analytical experience, ideally in complex, asset-intensive, or customer-driven organizations (maritime, terminals, logistics, or infrastructure a plus).
Experience establishing reporting catalogs, data definitions, or data stewardship/governance models; change leadership experience.
Knowledge of SQL, cloud data platforms, and/or ERP systems; familiarity with contract, pricing, billing, or ERP data and how commercial terms translate into revenue.
Experience working across geographies and multicultural environments; Spanish proficiency a plus.

Work environment:

Office environment; exposure to computer screens
Climate-controlled office environment, with exposure to computer screens and moderate noise levels typical of an office setting.
Minimal travel (less than 10%) to customer sites, industry events, and SSA Marine locations may be required.




Benefits: Benefits are provided to eligible employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life and accidental death insurance, paid disability insurance, paid parental leave when eligible, and an Employee Assistance Program. Employees will receive paid sick time, PTO, company holidays, and personal days. Eligible employees can enroll in our company's 401k plan with a company match, as well as a company-funded retirement plan. Employees will be eligible for discretionary and/or metric-based bonuses.

Title: Data & Dashboards Specialist (Data Centers)
Description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

This job opportunity is available at ANY location in the United States. Ideally, selected candidates will be near a JACOBS U.S. based office, but we intend to hire the "best" candidates.

We are looking for a Data & Dashboards Specialist (Power BI) to transform design, construction, and model data into clear, action-oriented insights for our data center portfolio.

You will sit inside the Digital Delivery / BIM team, working closely with BIM managers, project managers, construction managers, and automation/AI specialists. Your focus is not on “filling in” data, but on connecting to it, structuring it, and visualizing it—from early design through construction and closeout.

If you enjoy turning messy AEC data (models, RFIs, submittals, P6 schedules, financials, procurement feeds) into dashboards that teams actually rely on, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Dashboard Design & Delivery


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that support
Design and coordination progress
Model health and quality indicators
Issue/clash metrics and remediation
Program- and project-level KPIs across a multi-site portfolio
Create construction administration dashboards that track
Submittals (status, cycle times, responsible parties, bottlenecks)
RFIs (volume, response times, trends by discipline/location)
Daily reports / field reports (labor, quantities, weather impacts, safety, key events)
Translate stakeholder questions into clear visuals, metrics, and layouts that support real decisions
Support project teams during setup and key milestones, iterating dashboards based on feedback


Data Connections, APIs & Modeling


Connect Power BI to a range of systems and data sources, such as
ACC / CDEs, Revit model exports and schedules, Navisworks/coordination outputs
Construction administration systems (for RFIs, submittals, daily reports, field data)
Scheduling tools – especially Primavera P6 (planned vs. actual, critical path views, look-ahead dashboards)
Financial and procurement systems – including Unifier and Hexagon Smart Materials for
Commitments, invoices, and change orders
Procurement status, material tracking, and delivery milestones
Use APIs or automated data pipelines (where available) to enable
Direct connections from these platforms into Power BI
Automatic refreshes with minimal manual intervention
Develop and maintain data models, relationships, and DAX measures, and troubleshoot data quality and refresh issues


Standards, Templates & Reuse


Develop standard dashboard templates for recurring use cases, including
Construction admin dashboards (RFIs, submittals, daily reports)
Scheduling dashboards (P6 integration)
Financial/procurement dashboards (Unifier, Smart Materials)
Define and document standard measures, naming conventions, and visual patterns to ensure consistent reporting across programs and clients
Maintain lightweight documentation and handover guides so dashboards can be adopted and scaled


Collaboration with BIM, Construction, Automation & AI


Partner with
BIM managers to consume model and coordination data into dashboards
Construction and project managers to align dashboards with CA workflows, P6 updates, and financial/procurement processes
Provide data/visualization support for internal pilots, R&D initiatives, and executive reporting related to digital delivery, automation, and AI
Run short walkthroughs, demos, and quick reference sessions for project and construction teams on how to use dashboards


 

Here's what you'll need


Proven experience building Power BI dashboards, including
Data modeling, relationships, and DAX
Designing intuitive, user-friendly report pages
Experience working with AEC / BIM / construction data, such as
ACC or similar CDEs
Revit schedules or model exports
RFI/submittal logs, daily reports, or other CA data
Experience integrating or reporting on at least one of
Scheduling data (e.g., Primavera P6)
Construction financial or procurement data (e.g., Unifier, Hexagon Smart Materials, or comparable tools)
Comfort working with APIs or ETL tools to connect external systems to Power BI, and to configure automated data refresh
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to deal with imperfect, fragmented data and improve it over time
Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Ideally, you'll have


Experience with Revit, Navisworks, Civil 3D, or other BIM/coordination tools (conceptual understanding is sufficient)



Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $75,300.00 to $103,500.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on October 02, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

Title: Marketing Analytics Manager
Description:
About Impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight.

As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on.

What You'll Do:


Own the process for the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that marketing and sales leaders use to track campaign performance and business trends — and improve them over time so they drive decisions rather than descriptions.
Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently.
Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money.
Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy.
Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model.


What You Bring:


5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business.
A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python — enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help.
A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting.
Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action.
Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things.


Nice to Have:


Experience with attribution modeling — multi-touch, time decay, incrementality
Experience with lead scoring
Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective
Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool
Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing


Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000 per year, plus an additional 5% variable annual bonus contingent on Company performance and eligible to receive a Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) grant.


This is the pay range the Company believes is equitable for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.


Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.


Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
Office-only catered lunch every Thursday, a healthy snack bar, and great coffee to keep you fueled
Flexible spending accounts and 401(k)
Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.
Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

All employees and applicants for employment shall be given fair treatment and equal employment opportunity regardless of their race, ethnicity or ancestry, color or caste, religion or belief, age, sex (including gender identity, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy/maternity), national origin, weight, neurodivergence, disability, marital and civil partnership status, caregiving status, veteran status, genetic information, political affiliation, or other prohibited non-merit factors.

Title: Senior Sales Analytics Analyst
Description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Overview:

As the largest food & beverage company in the world, we sell over a billion products every day. Nestle’s sales team is the driving force behind every unit sold, focused on building strong categories by delighting our consumers while representing Nestle’s iconic brands with our retail partners.

The Sales Analytics team is the analytical intelligence engine that powers our Divisional sales & headquarter teams. The insights, data, and analytical expertise that our Sr Sales Analysts provide shape our strategic business decisions and equip our sales team to meet our consumer needs and drive category growth. The Sr. Analyst supports the division sales & CDCE team by leading strategic analytical initiatives and retailer/division-centric reporting that span across divisional categories.

Key Responsibilities:

The Sr. Analyst designs and deploys custom analytical solutions and team specific scorecards/dashboards to meet the unique needs of their Division Team. They serve as the analytical expert by leading multi-category requests and by providing insights and support to field sales leaders. The Sr. Analyst also plays a lead role on the Sales Analytics team, responsible for coaching, training, and onboarding Analysts.


Utilize multiple data sources to compile analysis and provide recommendations that drive positive ROI for the sales organization focusing on the so what, now what.
Strategize, advise and provide ad hoc support for VP/Director/Sr. Managers on opportunities for profitable growth
Identify team priorities and goals and develop trackers
Champion the use and application of standard sales analytics reports to meet the organization’s needs
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence Analysts to deliver best-in-class dashboards and scorecards for stakeholders
Provide superior customer service, being the point of contact for all faucets of sales analytics support


Division/Retailer Focused Insights & Reporting: Lead and provide retail/division-focused analytical support.


Translate complex business needs into actionable reporting, analytics, and insights that drive informed decision-making.
Maintain a holistic understanding of the wholesaler/retailer, category, and business landscape to proactively identify opportunities and improve selling capabilities.
Deliver actionable customer, category, and retail insights that support commercial planning, business planning, and sales execution.
Conduct root-cause, post-event, and benchmark analyses to evaluate performance, address business challenges, and identify growth opportunities.
Leverage internal, retail POS & movement data to provide fact-based recommendations, customer-facing selling tools, and category insights.
Support business performance through forecast accuracy, sales target attainment, segmentation, resource allocation, and customer service improvement.
Partner with CIH to transform 4Ps analytics and insights into business actions that drive growth.
Ensure timely and effective communication of customer, category, and forecast information to key stakeholders.


Elevate & Expand Sales Analytics Partnerships: Responsible for driving continuous improvement within the broader sales analytics tam through executing key projects and demonstrating peer-to-peer leadership. The Sr. Analyst will demonstrate role model behaviors within the sales analytics team by upskilling the analyst community through coaching and onboarding.


Owns and executes key sales analytics processes and provides sales analytics leadership with assistance on complex projects/initiatives.
Lead onboarding, provide continuous development, and fosters team collaboration for the Analysts on their respective sales analytics team
Own the deployment and training of sales analytics resources


Requirements:


3+ years of experience in sales analytics and reporting
Proficiency with Circana, Nielsen and other syndicated data, Excel, PowerPoint and PowerBi data management and data visualization.
Experience manipulating, managing, and drawing insights from large amounts of data
Experience driving insights and storytelling through the use of data.
Proven ability to routinely lead and foster collaboration among teammates
Ability to take initiative and drive improvement across the organization
Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
Organization and accuracy skills with excellent attention to detail
Demonstrates a thorough understanding of the sales fundamentals
Strong judgement in decision making, good problem-solving skills, and thinks strategically
Doesn’t hesitate to act and takes the initiative to execute with minimal supervision
Takes immediate action to resolve issues or potential issues, ensuring stakeholders are properly communicated to about the potential impact


Preferred:


Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution preferred.
Project Management skills or experience


Salary: $87,105.60 to $125,732.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.
