From the beginning, Starbucks set out to be a different kind of company. One that not only

celebrated coffee and the rich tradition, but that also brought a feeling of connection. We are known for developing extraordinary leaders who share this passion and are guided by their service to others.

As decision scientist for Partner (Employee) Analytics within the broader Partner Resources organization, you will be responsible for conducting complex analyses to deliver critical insights that guide strategic decisions across the partner domain, to include talent management, compensation, benefits, partner/labor relations, and operational excellence. The successful candidate for this role will thrive in a highly cross-functional working environment, possess strong analysis and insights generation capabilities, and have the intellectual curiosity to dive deep into complex problems.

As a decision scientist, you will…


Conduct data manipulation and analysis – You will collect requirements to identify appropriate methodologies, extract and transform large-scale data sets from a variety of systems, and perform analysis with high quality and statistical rigor.
Craft compelling narratives backed by data – You will synthesize analytical findings into actionable recommendations, produce relevant visualizations and narratives, and present findings to stakeholders, requiring the ability to communicate complex technical material to nontechnical audiences in an approachable way.
Effectively plan & prioritize work – You will proactively manage deadlines and ensure work is aligned to enterprise priorities, identifying risks when they arise.


We’d Love To Hear From People With


Bachelor’s degree with quantitative emphasis: Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Psychology, or related field.
1 or more years related experience applying analytics to complex business questions with knowledge in statistics (descriptive, regression, etc.)
Experience with coding languages to support data preparation (SQL), pipelines (Python), and data analysis (R, Python)
Experience with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI)
Labor or Workforce Analytics preferred.
Ability to handle and maintain the confidentiality of highly sensitive information
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail


As a Starbucks partner, you (and your family) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, and other voluntary insurance benefits. Partners have access to short-term and long-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation from date of hire*, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 hours worked), eight paid holidays, and two personal days per year. Starbucks also offers eligible partners participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, a discounted company stock program (S.I.P.), Starbucks equity program (Bean Stock), incentivized emergency savings, and financial well-being tools. Additionally, Starbucks offers 100% upfront tuition coverage for a first-time bachelor’s degree through Arizona State University’s online program via the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, student loan management resources, and access to other educational opportunities. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. Starbucks will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, and in accordance with its plans and policies. This list is subject to change depending on collective bargaining in locations where partners have a certified bargaining representative. For additional information regarding partner perks and more detailed information about benefits, go to starbucksbenefits.com.


If you are working in CA, CO, IL, LA, ME, MA, NE, ND or RI, you will accrue vacation up to a maximum of 120 hours (190 in CA) for roles below director and 200 hours (316 in CA) for roles at director or above. For roles in other states, you will be granted vacation time starting at 120 hours annually for roles below director and 200 hours annually for roles director and above.

Title: Senior Marketing Analytics Lead - Minecraft
Description:
Overview

At Mojang Studios, the creators of Minecraft, we are on a mission to build a better world through the power of play.

Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It’s the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. From the relentless experimentation of our endlessly inspiring community to the classrooms where Minecraft has become an essential teaching tool, play is the bedrock of our existence.

We enable millions to create and play together, connect people across the globe, and foster a community that is among the most active and passionate in the world. Our community is global and incredibly diverse. When we are developing anything within our franchise, we keep this in mind. We want everyone to not only feel included in Minecraft, but also to see themselves in what we make. Our goal is for the Mojang Studios team to be as diverse as our community.

The Player and Data Insights team is seeking a Marketing Analytics Lead to shape how Mojang Studios measures, optimizes, and grows the impact of its marketing investments. You will partner closely with Marketing and Data Science teams to develop measurement strategies, evaluate marketing performance, and identify opportunities to drive player acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. This role combines marketing analytics, business intelligence, measurement strategy, and executive storytelling to connect campaign performance with player and business outcomes. You will develop scalable reporting, trusted measurement frameworks, and AI-enabled analytics capabilities that help teams make faster, more informed decisions.

In the end, it’s the people of Mojang Studios that make this place truly special. When you join, you’ll find yourself in the company of incredibly bright, warm, and creative individuals – all united and working toward a single goal. Come help us reach it!

Responsibilities


Partner with Marketing leaders to define success metrics, measurement plans, and key performance indicators for campaigns, channels, and strategic initiatives.
Develop and maintain executive scorecards, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide a trusted view of marketing performance.
Analyze campaign, channel, and player behavior data to uncover actionable insights and opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
Translate complex marketing and player data into clear recommendations that influence planning, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Partner with Data Science teams to evaluate marketing performance, understand key business drivers, and measure the impact of marketing initiatives.
Establish consistent metrics, reporting standards, and measurement frameworks that improve trust and alignment across marketing reporting.
Deliver recurring business reviews and performance narratives that connect marketing activity to player engagement and business outcomes.
Evaluate emerging analytics and AI capabilities that improve reporting, insight generation, and access to data-driven decision making.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 2+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications


8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data analytics, business intelligence, or related fields, or equivalent experience.
Experience partnering with Marketing leaders to define measurement strategies, evaluate performance, and drive data-informed decision making.
Experience developing executive dashboards, scorecards, business reviews, and reporting solutions that enable strategic decision making.
Advanced SQL and/or Python skills with experience analyzing large-scale customer, player, marketing, or digital engagement datasets.
Experience analyzing and interpreting performance data across paid media, lifecycle marketing, CRM, web analytics, or other digital marketing channels.
Experience translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience applying AI-enabled analytics, automation, or self-service reporting capabilities to improve insight generation and data accessibility.
Passion for games, player experiences, and data-informed decision making.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Partner Experience & Supply Chain
Description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

What You'll Do

Join Prime Video's Partner Experience & Supply Chain team as a Business Intelligence Engineer and become the data expert who transforms how we work with our content partners and optimize our supply chain.

You'll be the go-to person for turning complex supply chain data into clear insights that drive real decisions. Working alongside product managers, engineers, and operations teams, you'll build the analytics tools and dashboards that help everyone understand what's working, what's not, and where we should focus next.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change - insights do. You'll tackle questions like: Where are the bottlenecks slowing down content delivery? Which partner workflows need improvement? How can we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You'll create the visibility tools that turn these questions into actionable answers, helping teams spot trends early and make confident, data-backed decisions.

What Makes This Role Different

You won't just be running reports - you'll be a strategic partner shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. Your work will directly influence how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide.

You'll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and build the tools that matter most. If you love diving deep into data, translating complexity into clarity, and seeing your insights drive tangible improvements, this role offers that impact.

Key job responsibilities


Analyze data to identify and execute on business opportunities
Understand data resources and select appropriate sources for each analysis
Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products
Evaluate requirements and select optimal tools, balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability
Build data pipelines and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets to report product metrics and KPIs
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders verbally and in writing


About The Team

We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
Proven ability to determine when and how to integrate GenAI tools, evaluate and refine GenAI outputs, and apply responsible AI practices to augment productivity and quality

Description:
Locations: Seattle | Chicago | Atlanta

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You will support the North American Talent Acquisition Analytics team in analyzing data and generating insights that shape our talent acquisition strategies. This role offers the opportunity to develop advanced analytical skills and gain a deep understanding of how analytics drives business success within a leading global consulting firm. The Talent Acquisition Assistant must have advanced technical knowledge, effective communication skills, both written and verbal, the ability to work independently, prioritize work, and have a proactive approach. This position demands outstanding multi-tasking ability and an eagerness to learn. Attention to detail, ability to deal with ambiguity, and strong customer service ethics are needed for success.

You’re good at


Analyze large datasets related to recruitment metrics, candidate pipelines, and hiring trends. Develop visualizations to effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.
Perform data cleaning, transformation, and integration to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data for analysis.
Produce regular reports on key recruitment metrics and provide actionable insights to BCG’s Talent Acquisition team.
Work closely with recruiters, cohort teams, and other business functions to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analytics solutions.
Identify and implement automation opportunities for repetitive tasks within the recruitment process using scripts, tools, or other techniques.
Partnering with the Recruiting Operations and Analytics team to create and execute system reports and queries.
Assisting with special projects and analyses as needed.


What You'll Bring


BA/BS degree required; majors with a quantitative focus preferred (STEM, economics, finance, sociology)
0-2 years of recruiting, HR, or relevant work experience
Intermediate or higher proficiency in Python or SQL for data analysis
Strong skills in data cleaning, preprocessing, and analysis
Familiarity with Microsoft Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and other tools, for data analysis, reporting, and presentations
Ability to approach complex problems analytically and develop innovative solutions
Excellent organizational skills; demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, manage time effectively, and handle competing priorities
Meticulous attention to detail and follow-through; performing tasks with high degree of accuracy
Outstanding interpersonal skills; convey a positive personal and professional image consistent with the firm’s culture and value
Maturity and professionalism at all times; recognize and maintain confidentiality
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team; build strong relationships with people at all levels of the organization
Strong service orientation in responding to stakeholder needs
A high degree of flexibility in a demanding, fast-paced, and frequently changing environment; demonstrate ability to remain calm under pressure and comfort working with minimal direction
A self-starting attitude; proactively identify issues, and generate solutions


Who You'll Work With

You will work with members of our NAMR Talent Acquisition function, as well as BCG People Team and technical stakeholders as needed, to ensure effective, data driven decision making in recruiting.

Additional info

Format

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person work is essential to our culture, mentorship, and professional development. That's why we operate on a hybrid model, with the expectation that team members will be in the office 3 to 5 days per week. This role is designed for those who thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment and is not intended for remote or virtual work.

Compensation

Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, retirement contribution, and a market leading benefits package described below.

The base salary range for this role begins at $57,000 in our lowest cost geography and goes up to $79,000 in our highest cost geography. Your recruiting contact can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

This is an estimated range and specific base salaries within the range depend on various factors such as office location, experience, and skill set. In addition to your base salary, your total compensation will include a discretionary bonus of up to 12% and a generous retirement contribution that starts at 5% and moves to 10% after 2 years.

At BCG, we are committed to offering a comprehensive benefit program that includes everything our employees and their families need to be well and live life to the fullest. We pay the full cost of medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees – and their eligible family members.* That’s zero dollars in premiums taken from employee paychecks.

All Of Our Plans Provide Best In Class Coverage


Zero dollar ($0) health insurance premiums for BCG employees, spouses, and children
Low $10 (USD) copays for trips to the doctor, urgent care visits and prescriptions for generic drugs
Dental coverage, including up to $5,000 in orthodontia benefits
Vision insurance with coverage for both glasses and contact lenses annually
Reimbursement for gym memberships and other fitness activities
Fully vested retirement contributions made annually, whether you contribute or not, plus the option for employees to make personal contributions to a 401(k) plan
Paid Parental Leave and other family benefits such as elective egg freezing, surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement
Generous paid time off including 12 holidays per year, an annual office closure between Christmas and New Years, and 15 vacation days per year (earned at 1.25 days per month)
Paid sick time on an as needed basis

Primary Responsibilities

Functional Responsibilities:


Collaborate with client executives and team members to understand organizational needs and recommend appropriate data-driven solutions.
Work closely with West Monroe project team members to deliver valuable outcomes.
Own and complete project tasks under management guidance.
Evaluate and document client business processes and requirements.
Develop and test investment hypotheses using data science methodologies to drive actionable insights.
Assist in the creation of detailed business cases and strategic recommendations.


Technical Responsibilities


Utilize database development and scripting skills, including SQL, Python, PySpark, and R, for data manipulation and analysis.
Perform end-to-end data science workflows, from data ingestion and wrangling to analysis and visualization.
Design and develop reports, dashboards, and visualization tools using platforms like Tableau and Power BI.

Apply AI technologies, including generative AI, automation tools, and data models, to enhance insights, improve delivery efficiency, and elevate the quality of client outcomes.


Internal Responsibilities


Actively participate in West Monroe’s culture and social events.
Expand your knowledge of data science, analytics, and data engineering methodologies by participating in competency teams, attending learning sessions, and studying for and attaining technical certifications.

Sharp analytical thinking and an interest in solving complex problems.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI, and a passion for continuous learning and innovation.

Bachelor’s degree in progress, with an expected graduation date between December 2026 and August 2027. Candidates must currently be on track to graduate within this window. The graduation date will be verified.
Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0.

Reside within 50 miles of your assigned office prior to your start date. Our culture emphasizes team collaboration within a hybrid work model.

Experience integrating AI tools, such as ChatGPT, into day-to-day workflows to enhance productivity and insight generation, coupled with strong critical thinking to assess accuracy, mitigate bias, and ensure high-quality outputs.

Business Analytics

Data Science
Economics
Informatics
Information Systems
Statistics

Title: Senior Business Operations Associate
Description:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com

Application Deadline: 10/1/2026

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Associate to help redefine how BizOps gets done at DAT. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of strategy, business intelligence, and applied AI: you'll deliver the insights leaders rely on for strategic decisions, while designing and deploying AI agents that scale and extend our analytics capabilities.

You'll partner with stakeholders across the business to surface high-value problems, develop and report on KPIs that inform target priorities and team performance, and build agentic workflows that turn recurring tasks into self-service tools. With each analysis, you'll ask the natural follow-up: what can an agent do to complement this next time?

This is a high-impact IC role with meaningful visibility at the leadership level. Agents are rapidly transforming internal BizOps functions, and you'll shape how we incorporate them into ours.

What You’ll Do

Develop and operate agentic solutions to traditional business intelligence responsibilities:


Strategic Oversight: Support leadership in developing and executing business strategies. Assist with setting organizational goals, tracking progress, and ensuring alignment across departments.
KPI development & ownership: Develop and own the key performance indicators that leadership uses to measure business health, ensuring metrics stay aligned with evolving strategic priorities.
Strategic & ad-hoc analysis: Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing to scope analytical questions, deliver deep-dive insights, and translate findings into clear recommendations that drive business decisions.
BI development & reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that make key business metrics accessible, accurate, and trustworthy across the organization.
Agent design & deployment: Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents that augment workflows, including agents that monitor metrics for anomalies, generate narrative summaries, answer ad-hoc data questions, and automate routine reporting cycles.
Performance monitoring & iteration: Track how deployed agents and dashboards perform in the wild, gather feedback from end users, and continuously refine outputs to improve accuracy, usefulness, and adoption over time.
Automation opportunity identification: Spot repetitive analytical tasks across the organization and evaluate which are best suited for agentic automation versus traditional BI tooling, balancing impact, complexity, and risk.
Data quality & integrity: Partner with Data Engineering to validate source data, surface inconsistencies, and ensure that both human-facing analyses and agent outputs are built on a trustworthy foundation.
Documentation & enablement: Document agent capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases so stakeholders know when to trust outputs and when to escalate or verify.


The Skills And Experience You’ll Bring


3-5 years in high-growth startups, strategy consulting, business intelligence, data analytics or specialized BizOps roles. Series A–C experience is a significant plus.
Strong SQL and Excel skills. You can independently get to the data you need and build the models behind your own reporting.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Daily working fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day work; comfortable writing clear prompts, evaluating outputs, debugging agent behavior, and knowing when human judgment must override automation.
Growth mindset and a willingness to work hard; this will be a high-effort, high-reward type role for those excited about building business leverage with AI.


Nice to Haves:


Experience deploying AI agents or LLM-powered tools, including thinking through evaluation, monitoring, and failure modes.
Experience in logistics, fintech, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS businesses.


Why DAT?

DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.


Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance
Parental Leave
Flexible Time Off
An additional 10 holidays of paid time off per calendar year
401k matching (immediately vested)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Short- and Long-term disability sick leave
Flexible Spending Accounts
Health Savings Accounts
Employee Assistance Program
Additional programs - Employee Referral, Internal Recognition, and Wellness
Free TriMet transit pass (Beaverton Office)
Competitive salary and benefits package
Work on impactful projects in a cutting-edge environment
Collaborative and supportive team culture
Opportunity to make a real difference in the trucking industry
Employee Resource Groups

DAT considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education and training, core skills, internal equity, and market and business elements when extending an offer.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Analyst II

Position Overview

Seeking a detail-oriented Technical Operations Analyst II to support its global Tax & Compliance Technology team. This individual will help maintain the accuracy, reliability, and performance of tax technology systems supporting the global travel marketplace.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in SQL, data analysis, and advanced Excel, with experience troubleshooting technical issues, identifying data anomalies, and building or supporting reporting dashboards. This role will involve investigating system issues, maintaining tax configurations, supporting jurisdiction launches, monitoring operational performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure tax technology processes run efficiently.

This is a hands-on individual contributor position suited for someone who enjoys working with data, solving technical problems, improving processes, and supporting business-critical technology operations.

Key Responsibilities

Execute approved tax content and configuration updates for various jurisdictions, including tax rates, tax codes, geocodes, effective dates, and taxability settings.
Investigate and troubleshoot complex or non-standard tax technology issues by analyzing data, identifying root causes, and validating corrective actions.
Support jurisdiction launches, monthly tax content updates, tax engine changes, and compliance initiatives through testing, production validation, and operational readiness activities.
Monitor operational queues, reports, and dashboards to identify anomalies, recurring issues, data-quality gaps, and performance trends.
Build, maintain, and support reporting tools, dashboards, and spreadsheets to improve visibility into operational performance and system health.
Utilize SQL and advanced Excel to analyze large datasets, investigate discrepancies, and support data-driven decision-making.
Collaborate with Tax, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Market Management, Partner Support, and external technology vendors to resolve issues and coordinate operational changes.
Maintain accurate documentation, including runbooks, knowledge articles, ticket histories, audit evidence, and troubleshooting procedures.
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve reporting capabilities, and leverage automation to reduce manual effort and recurring incidents.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, Tax, Accounting, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
2+ years of experience in technical operations, tax operations, compliance operations, data analysis, or a related field.
Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing data to investigate issues, identify trends, and resolve discrepancies.
Advanced Excel and spreadsheet skills, including data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and dashboard development.
Experience with technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and validating solutions to operational or system-related issues.
Experience building, maintaining, or supporting dashboards and reporting tools.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet time-sensitive deadlines, and follow established change management and escalation procedures.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Excel dashboards.
Experience with tax technology platforms or systems such as Vertex, Avalara, or comparable tax engines.
Knowledge of indirect taxation, tax content management, tax determination, jurisdictional tax rules, or regulatory compliance.
Familiarity with Jira, incident management platforms, ticketing systems, and operational support workflows.
Experience with user acceptance testing (UAT), production validation, configuration management, audit trails, and change controls.
Experience developing monitoring dashboards, identifying anomalies, conducting trend analysis, and improving data quality.
Familiarity with automation, AI-driven tools, and process improvement initiatives.

Technical Skills – Priority Order

SQL & Data Analysis – Querying, analyzing, and investigating datasets.
Advanced Excel – Spreadsheet analysis, reporting, data manipulation, and dashboard creation.
Technical Troubleshooting – Root cause analysis, issue investigation, and problem resolution.
Reporting & Visualization – Tableau, Power BI, Looker, and Excel dashboards.
Monitoring & Data Quality – Identifying anomalies, analyzing trends, and monitoring operational performance.
Tax Technology Systems – Tax engines, tax content, configuration, and compliance workflows.
Jira & Incident Management – Ticket tracking, issue documentation, and escalation management.

Title: Senior Data Analyst

The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree

Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell

Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Title: Sr Business Data Analyst
Description:
The Sr Business Data Analyst role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase General Bonus Plan and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to launch your analytics career in the fast-paced world of supply chain? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who is eager to apply data-driven thinking, build impactful visualizations, and support operational excellence. This is your opportunity to grow your skills, collaborate with warehouse leaders, and become a go-to resource for data tools and insights. If you're curious, analytical, and ready to lead, this role is for you.

Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.



Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
Implement and maintain standard reporting tools for the site or sector
Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and analytics community initiatives
Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to promote data literacy and tool adoption
Manage analytics projects independently and across multiple sites
Design and implement data pipelines (ETL) from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources
Apply Python, R, or other analytics tools to enhance reporting and automation
Stay current with modern data analytics trends and apply best practices to improve processes
Support site startups as needed by implementing analytics tools and reporting frameworks



Required Experience



Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
Extensive experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
Proficiency in writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
Experience designing and managing data pipelines and working with diverse data sources, required
Strong understanding of statistical concepts, data modeling techniques, and modern analytics trends, required
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, required
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional projects, required
Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required



Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC’s Advanced Energy Strategic Deployment team is seeking a Data Analyst II to support data management, analysis, and reporting across strategic projects that advance the energy sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing metrics and building reports for a variety of projects, with the knowledge and expertise to create, edit, and modify data sets and produce accurate, timely, and clear analytics for the team and our clients.

The ideal candidate is an independent, detail-oriented contributor with a positive attitude who excels at multitasking while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, efficiency, and reliability. They will bring curiosity about emerging tools—including AI—and a desire to apply data analytics, visualization, and geospatial techniques to real-world advanced energy challenges. A sufficient understanding of the energy industry to interpret the data required for the position is preferred.

Why Consider This Job Opportunity?


Advance your career through ongoing learning and development
Maintain a healthy work-life balance with supportive policies
Collaborate within an inclusive and respectful team environment
Contribute to a rapidly expanding and future-focused industry
Support impactful projects driving the clean energy transition


Responsibilities


Provide valuable insight to program teams based on the data collected, enabling informed decision-making.
Build and maintain customized dashboards and reporting for clients, subcontractors, management, and cross-functional team members in our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database.
Sort through and interpret high quantities of data, identifying, diagnosing, and correcting discrepancies to ensure accuracy.
Develop data models through reporting and visualization to support decision-making.
Monitor and report program key performance metrics and provide updates to management.
Support program platform tasks, including configuration, dashboards, and data import/export as directed.
Provide input for troubleshooting, process improvements, automation, and system enhancements.
Research and present market intelligence and customer trends to support strategic advanced energy projects.
Explore and pilot AI-enabled and geospatial (GIS) approaches to streamline data-intensive processes and enhance analysis.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Geography/GIS, Engineering, Environmental Studies, a related field, or equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience performing data analysis and using tools to create reports, dashboards, and data exploration.
Residency in the Denver, Colorado area preferred.
Advanced computer skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams); advanced Excel skills preferred.
Experience with data analysis and visualization software (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Tableau, R, or Python).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong time-management skills, and attention to detail.
Ability to contribute to multiple projects simultaneously with demonstrated accuracy and reliability.
Experience applying AI / machine-learning tools to data analysis, automation, or reporting.
Strong Power BI development skills (data modeling, DAX, interactive dashboards).
Microsoft Enterprise ecosystem experience, including Microsoft Dynamics (a plus), Power Platform, and SharePoint.
ArcGIS / Esri experience for spatial data creation, analysis, and visualization.
Additional data analytics skills such as SQL, Python, R, or data-pipeline/API integration.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, and self-direct across many concurrent stretch assignments in a high-paced, high-accountability environment with minimal oversight.
Strong interest or experience supporting projects in the energy space, such as energy efficiency (EE), demand response (DR), distributed energy resource management systems (DERMS), or similar utility/clean-energy projects.


Benefits*: TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:


Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.
TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence.
These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees.


Compensation: In accordance with local law, the below salary range is applicable for the job and location associated with this requisition. Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors.

Other Compensation: Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee.

Disclaimers

TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

Salary Range

USD $70,586.88 - USD $85,000.00 /Yr.

Description:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.

This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.

The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

Essential Responsibilities


Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.

Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.

Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities


Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).


Qualifications / Experience Required


Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.

Write queries and scripts to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from enterprise databases.
Support the generation of recurring and ad hoc reports for operational and leadership teams.
Contribute to the design and implementation of data models and workflows that enhance reporting efficiency.
Conduct data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting outputs.
Document data sources, processes, and report specifications for continuity and audit readiness.
Collaborate with IT teams and database administrators to troubleshoot data access and integration issues.
Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives, operational planning, and mission readiness assessments.
Ensure compliance with USSOCOM data governance, classification, and cybersecurity standards.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.

Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance or ability to upgrade

Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.
Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or .NET).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access.
Ability to develop data visualizations that inform leadership decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

It’s GREAT if you also have:

Experience with Microsoft SharePoint integration for data visualization or workflow automation.
Experience with MAVEN platforms
2+ years designing Palantir Foundry workflows: engineering data pipelines, modeling
ontologies, and deploying BI applications to support mission-critical decisions




Education:

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

The role sits at the intersection of data engineering and business analytics - building reliable, well-modeled data assets and turning them into analyses that drive product, growth, and operations decisions.

The Data Analyst will work closely with analytics engineers, data engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to define metrics, instrument them correctly, and ship dashboards and analyses that leadership actually uses. The role matters because decisions at the company are made on data, and this is one of the people accountable for making that data trustworthy.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain metrics layers and semantic models in dbt, ensuring consistent definitions across dashboards and ad-hoc analyses
Write performant SQL against a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to answer product, growth, and operational questions
Build and maintain dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Mode for leadership and cross-functional partners, with documented metric definitions
Own end-to-end analyses - cohort retention, funnel conversion, A/B test readouts, unit economics - from framing through presentation
Partner with data engineers on data quality: set up monitoring, validate dbt model outputs, and triage pipeline anomalies
Translate ambiguous stakeholder requests into clear analytical questions, deliverables, and timelines
Document analyses, metric definitions, and methodologies so findings are reproducible and auditable


What We Are Looking For


3-6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering
Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy) for analysis and data manipulation
Hands-on experience with dbt and a modern data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
Track record of shipping dashboards and self-serve analytics in Looker, Tableau, or Mode
Solid statistics fundamentals: hypothesis testing, regression, experiment analysis, and common analytical pitfalls
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, engineering) or equivalent practical experience
Bonus: experience with data visualization libraries (Plotly, Streamlit), reverse ETL tools, event tracking design (Segment, Amplitude), or owning an A/B testing program

Collect and consolidate data from various sources related to application performance, usage, and migration progress
Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across all datasets
Conduct in-depth analysis of application data to identify patterns, trends, and potential issues

Create compelling visual representations of data findings using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Develop and deliver presentations on migration analytics to various levels of the organization
Conduct pre- and post-migration comparisons to evaluate the success of migration efforts

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive!

Benefits & Perks


Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.
Wellness & Growth – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.


To learn more about our offerings, click here.

What You'll Do

The Senior Data Analyst (Partner Analytics) will work across the organization to support new and ongoing initiatives. This person will be an early member of a highly experienced and passionate team and will play a key role in defining the future of the organization. The associate’s primary focus will be supporting and advancing initiatives across analytics and operational performance in collaboration with both the new market & business development team, as well as the organization overall.

Essential Functions


Research, hypothesize and develop analytical approaches for identifying, analyzing, and interpreting trends or patterns in complex data sets, particularly in healthcare claims & lab data.
Ability to conceptualize and design innovative models to assess viability of new and ongoing initiatives and clinical programs.
Collaborate with team members from strategy, clinical and new market functions to identify data driven opportunities to add value to existing and potential partners.
Perform ad-hoc analysis for internal and external stakeholders.
Design and build self-service dashboards to measure performance and assist in directing team’s efforts towards initiatives with the largest impact.
Identify, communicate, and lead the resolution of data gaps that impede the fulfilment of operational reporting and oversight.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree with strong academic achievement.
Located in Denver, or willing to relocate.
2+ years’ experience in healthcare data analysis.
Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency
Ability to travel and be onsite to meet business needs.


Preferred Qualifications


Working knowledge of analyzing medical claim, lab data, EMR data and clinical data.
High degree of proficiency in Microsoft SQL, Excel & PowerPoint.
Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort in ambiguity; desire to be a self-starter.
Must be comfortable speaking and leading analytical discussions with partners.

Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

At Hill Physicians Medical Group, we’re shaping the healthcare of the future: actively managed care that prevents disease, supports those with chronic conditions and anticipates the needs of our members.

Join Our Team!

Hill Physicians has much to offer prospective employees. We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

DE&I Statement:

At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.

Job Description:

The Analyst supports data-informed initiatives, including clinical quality, financial performance, and population health by gathering, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data as a compelling story to the Hill Physicians team and its collaborating partners. Within this classification, analysts may focus on reporting and visualization, or analytical consultation and modeling. Analysts work as members of teams committed to using and promoting industry-standard best practices and to addressing new problems with innovative solutions.

Job Responsibilities:


Define analysis requirements and interprets analytic results, identify primary drivers
Conduct driver analysis to identify key factors influencing health outcomes and predict future utilization of health care services
Independently fulfill asks with appropriate use of analytical methods, trend analysis, report design and development
Perform in-depth data analyses of reports and datasets, e.g., of medical claims and pharmacy data, and offer narrative interpretations and business recommendations or conclusions, where appropriate
Assist internal and external stakeholders with appropriate use of standardized reports, analytical approaches to population management and quality improvement programs
Collaborate with end users to assess reporting requirements and translate business needs into actionable insights, guiding the analytical approach to deliver relevant and impactful data-driven solutions
Work with advanced graphic tools, including dashboards and other visual displays, to provide clear and insightful views of performance
Utilize advanced querying techniques for complex data manipulation and statistical analyses



Knowledge, Experience & Skills:


Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, informatics, statistics, public health, or related field with coursework in quantitative analysis
Master’s degree preferred
Minimum 2 years of professional analytics-related experience.
Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment, prioritize multiple projects and problem-solve under tight deadlines and resource constraints
Clear written and interpersonal communication skills and presentation skills, including ability to present complex technical concepts in a clear, concise manner to audiences with varying levels of technical understanding
Demonstrated ability to work independently and to function as an integral part of a team in a rapidly changing work environment
Familiarity with basic healthcare data sets such as patient records, claims data, and demographic information.
Basic understanding of healthcare processes, including how clinical data, claims, and authorizations flow through the system.
Knowledge of key healthcare metrics and apply them to business and operational analysis, such as cost analysis, utilization rates, and clinical performance.
Ability to conduct more advanced data analysis, such as trend analysis, outlier identification, driver identification, with some guidance.
Proficiency in Microsoft suite, including pivot tables and advanced formulas and functions
Proficiency in querying languages such as SQL
Experience with advanced data visualization tools such as Tableau or GIS software (ArcGIS) preferred
Experience with advanced analytic programs/languages such as SAS or R preferred



Additional Information:

Salary: $87,000 - $113,000 Annual

Hill Physicians is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Data Analyst II, Customer Reporting
Description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are looking for a customer-centric and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to join the Customer Reporting team. Reporting to the Manager, Customer Reporting, you will be responsible for delivering custom and standard reporting that demonstrates the impact of Spring Health to its customers. You will collaborate closely with Customer Success and Subject Matter Experts to refine Spring’s storytelling strategy and data artifacts. This role is expected to support a combination of ad hoc requests and dashboard development.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 44 Montgomery Street location. Candidates must be based in the San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites. Periodic travel of up to 25% is expected for team collaboration and company events. If you are passionate about using data to create meaningful impact and thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do


Delivering analyses and dashboards to customers and internal stakeholders they need to tell compelling stories about Spring Health’s impact
Diving into different data sources, quickly building expertise on what is possible, and developing creative solutions based on your stakeholder’s needs
Developing a deep understanding of our products and how we tell the story of their impact to customers
Collaborate with Product to inform how we evolve our customer data story and expand our standard suite of reporting
Surface opportunities to automate and scale commonly requested reports and data sets
Become an expert working with our data stack including Snowflake, Looker, dbt, and Hex


What Success Looks Like


Customers and internal stakeholders are highly satisfied with the quality of work produced
Customers and internal stakeholders trust the data provided to them; reports and data sets are reviewed for data consistency and data quality
Requests are completed in a timely manner while still prioritizing a high standard of quality
Bring ideas forward that can reduce the amount of time spent manually pulling data to inform decisions
Dashboards and analyses deliver ongoing value to stakeholders


What You’ll Bring


You are strong with SQL and are able to effectively query data across many sources
You have 3+ years of working experience working with data, data visualization, and dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.
Strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail
You focus on impact, finding the things you can deliver that deliver the most value for your stakeholders
You have exceptional communication skills, are comfortable explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience
You are humble, highly motivated, and thrive in fast-paced environments
You have a passion for successfully navigating ambiguous problem areas and learning new approaches
Prior experience with R is nice to have
Prior experience with dbt is nice to have
You are passionate about changing the face of mental health care, and Spring Health’s mission to remove all barriers to mental health resonates with you
Ability to travel periodically (

Benefits Provided By Spring Health

Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.
Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning
A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.

Access to Noom, a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals.
Access to fertility care support through Carrot, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.
Access to Wellhub, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription
Access to BrightHorizons, which provides sponsored child care, back-up care, and elder care
