We're looking for a Data Analyst to serve as a critical analytical partner across customer service, operations, and direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels. This role sits at the center of data, insights, and decision-making, providing visibility into customer behavior, operational performance, and ecommerce trends to help drive better business outcomes.

Reporting to the Director, DTC, Operations, Customer Service & PMO, this individual will own the development and maintenance of key reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that enable teams to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve the customer experience.

You will work cross-functionally with Customer Service, Operations, Ecommerce, Marketing, Supply Chain, and external partners to transform data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable working across multiple datasets and systems, and passionate about building scalable reporting solutions that improve visibility and decision making.

If you're motivated by turning complex data into meaningful business insights and enjoy influencing outcomes through analytics, this role provides significant ownership and impact.

This is an onsite opportunity in Alameda, CA.

What You’ll Work On


Own customer service analytics and reporting, delivering insights into performance, customer behavior, and operational effectiveness.
Analyze key customer service metrics including contact volume, case resolution, escalations, response times, customer satisfaction, and root causes of customer issues.

Title: Sr. Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities


Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it


About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!


5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question


Working Style


Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go


Nice-to-Haves


Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience
B2B SaaS with both sales-led and self-serve motions
Fintech, accounting software, or professional services background


About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?


We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan

Title: Senior Marketing Data and Research Analyst (Onsite)
Description:
What It Feels Like..

Most days it feels more like going to work with a big family. Whether it’s a potluck lunch, baking birthday cakes for colleagues in the kitchen, or after-hours get together, we’re here to do a great job and have a good time while doing it! We value a good sense of humor, are motivated by a higher purpose, and always bring an “in-this-together” attitude. While we’re driven to do great work, we also value real work/life balance.

Is This the Career for You?

SF Fire Credit Union is looking for a Senior Marketing Data and Research Analyst and Research who can conduct research, organize, analyze, and interpret data to drive and support the company's marketing efforts. They will work closely with the VP of Marketing and must be detail-oriented, able to prioritize projects, collaborate effectively, and manage deliverables aligned with business priorities.

The role demands a highly analytical thinker with a strong understanding of the digital media landscape, the ability to craft compelling data-driven narratives, and excellent project management skills. This individual will be responsible for identifying meaningful and actionable trends, establishing best practices based on historical and current marketing performance, and providing insights that influence future planning and decision-making.

This highly collaborative role will also partner closely with teams across Business Intelligence, IT, Accounting, and external agency partners to ensure data is accurately tracked, analyzed, and reported.

What You’ll Be Doing


Develop and maintain marketing measurement frameworks, including attribution models, funnel analysis, conversion tracking, and performance methodologies to evaluate marketing effectiveness, optimize investments, and improve member acquisition, engagement, retention, and ROI.
Analyze marketing, member, and business performance data across digital and traditional channels to identify trends, conversion opportunities, member behaviors, and actionable insights that inform strategic decision-making and campaign optimization.
Leverage advanced analytical techniques and statistical methodologies to identify root causes of business and marketing performance trends, uncover opportunities for growth, and provide actionable recommendations that drive strategic decision-making.
Lead market research and competitive intelligence initiatives, including member surveys, demographic analysis, peer benchmarking, industry trend monitoring, and market assessments to identify growth opportunities and evolving member needs.
Partner with growth, brand, and digital marketing teams to develop and optimize data-driven acquisition, engagement, retention, and product adoption strategies across the member lifecycle.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, automated reporting solutions, and executive scorecards using Power BI, SQL, Python, GA4, BigQuery, Snowflake, and other business intelligence tools to support ongoing performance monitoring and decision-making.
Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for data sources, business definitions, reporting methodologies, attribution models, dashboard logic, campaign measurement frameworks, data governance standards, and analytical processes to ensure consistency, transparency, and knowledge sharing across teams.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Intelligence, IT, Accounting, Product, Retail, Digital Banking, and external agency partners to collect, validate, integrate, and manage data from different sources like core banking systems, online banking platforms, CRM systems, website analytics, surveys, and third-party marketing platforms to ensure data quality and reporting accuracy.
Translate complex analyses into clear business insights, recommendations, and executive-ready presentations that support marketing leadership, business stakeholders, and strategic planning efforts.
Deliver recurring performance reporting, including weekly campaign analyses, monthly business reviews, quarterly trend assessments, and ongoing optimization recommendations.
Partner with Marketing leadership to support annual marketing planning and budgeting processes, including budget forecasting, investment analysis, resource allocation recommendations, expense reconciliation, and performance-based optimization to maximize marketing effectiveness and return on investment.
Lead special projects, ad hoc analyses, and strategic initiatives that support organizational goals, member growth, and business performance.


What We Look For In You


Required: 5+ years of experience in a related role.
Required: Ability to work during Pacific Time business hours.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Financial services, banking, credit union, or highly regulated industry experience preferred.
Advanced proficiency in Snowflake, SQL, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), BigQuery, PowerBI, and other analytics or reporting platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing measurement, campaign analytics, audience segmentation, attribution methodologies, and customer lifecycle analysis.
Strong understanding of relational database concepts, including data modeling, table relationships, primary and foreign keys, joins, normalization, and data integration principles. Ability to analyze and combine data from multiple sources to support reporting, segmentation, marketing analytics, and business decision-making.
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into data file specifications and audience criteria for marketing programs, including campaign targeting, member segmentation, promotional eligibility, and performance measurement.
Experience analyzing member/customer behavior, digital engagement, website analytics, and marketing performance to support growth and retention strategies.
Demonstrated experience building dashboards, automated reporting solutions, data models, and executive-level performance reporting.
Strong market research and competitive intelligence capabilities, including survey design, benchmarking, and trend analysis.
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced PowerPoint and data storytelling skills, with the ability to develop executive-ready presentations and strategic recommendations.
Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Must be detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize projects, collaborate across teams, and manage deliverables aligned with business priorities and with strong quality control and data governance practices.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.
Strategic thinker with excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.


Salary

This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At SFFCU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for the San Francisco Market is an annual salary of $107,000 to $160,000.

Our Benefits

We have a competitive compensation and benefits package, but the true reward of working for SF Fire Credit Union goes beyond what you’ll see on a pay-stub. We genuinely care our employees and we strive to invest in their professional and personal growth. We’re a relatively small organization at about 200 employees, so you can see the impact of your efforts and the value your contributions bring to our members and fellow employees.


401(k) and Employer Match
Health, Vision, Dental and Life Insurance
Annual Incentive/Bonus Program
Tuition Reimbursement Program
11 Paid Holidays + Competitive PTO package
Home & Consumer Loan Program (Discounted Rates)
Professional development and training programs
On-demand personal coaching resource
Wellness Program (Discounted Gym Membership)

Team Overview

BlackRock SMA Solutions helps clients customize portfolios for unique tax, values-alignment, or investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi-asset. The Senior SMA Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and operational reliability of client and account data across Salesforce and Entity Master platforms supporting SMA Solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of business operations and technology, requiring a combination of hands-on data analysis, technical proficiency, and strong business judgment. The data analyst will play a critical role in resolving daily data discrepancies that impact account onboarding, servicing, and client workflows, while contributing to long-term data quality and automation initiatives.

The need for this role is driven by a continuous volume of data reconciliation issues that require dedicated ownership to maintain day-to-day business continuity.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and technical skills with business context to support account onboarding, client servicing, operational workflows, and strategic data quality initiatives across SMA Solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Perform manual reconciliation of data discrepancies between CRM and Master Data Management across various client defining objects
Resolve data breaks that impact operational workflows, including onboarding blockers and sync failures
Support the development of automated reconciliation capabilities as part of the broader data quality roadmap
Investigate recurring data issues, including:
Record merges originating from Data Operations Team
Duplicate records and conflicting attributes across systems
Missing or incomplete MDM records
Operationally significant contact conflicts
Conduct root cause analysis and recommend scalable, systemic solutions
Track and monitor ongoing data reconciliation issues and patterns
Develop reporting to quantify issue volume, trends, and business impact
Escalate high-frequency or systemic issues to Salesforce Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Operations teams for resolution
Utilize SQL, SOQL, and Excel to query, analyze, and remediate data across Salesforce and MDM datasets
Perform validation and reconciliation across multiple data sources, including Snowflake where applicable

Account onboarding and servicing workflows
Client hierarchy and relationship models
Operationally significant records and dependencies
Apply business context to inform reconciliation decisions and prioritization

Build process guides, playbooks, and onboarding materials

Partner cross-functionally across business, data operations, and IT Engineering teams
Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams to drive resolution of data issues

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field
Strong proficiency in SQL, SOQL, Excel, and data analysis techniques
Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM and enterprise data platforms
Familiarity with Snowflake, Power BI, Python, or similar analytical and reporting tools
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and reconciliation processes
Deep familiarity with relational data models, master data concepts, and complex entity relationships
Ability to investigate data issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement scalable solutions
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills


Preferred Qualifications


Experience within the financial services, wealth management, asset management, banking, or brokerage industry
Understanding of advisor, client, account, and corporate hierarchy structures, including intermediary and end-investor relationships
Experience supporting client data, master data, data quality, or reference data management functions
Experience designing or validating automated reconciliation processes and data quality controls

Title: Product Analytics - Developer Experience, Bridge
Description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We’re creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster / cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world’s leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb) and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

What you’ll do

We Are Looking For a Product Analyst To Join Our Data Team At Bridge. You'll Own The Data Strategy For Customer Experience At Bridge, Spanning Two Closely Linked Areas


Payments quality — transaction speed, uptime/reliability, error rates, and support ticket trends across our payment rails and products.
Product experience — how customers interact with Bridge's dashboard, onboarding flows, and other surfaces, and where friction is costing us adoption or trust.



This focus area may shift over time as the business evolves, and we're looking for someone who can adapt their scope accordingly — spinning up their knowledge of different product areas, creating new analyses and instrumentation as priorities emerge or change.

This is a high-ownership seat: you'll be the primary data voice for your focal area, expected to identify what matters, build the pipelines and analysis to prove it, and drive decisions from insight through to shipped outcomes — with real latitude to define how you get there.

Responsibilities


Own the data needs for your focal area end-to-end: define and refine the right metrics, build the pipelines to source them, and drive them into decisions — without needing significant hand-holding.
Analyze payments quality signals (latency, uptime, failure/error rates, support ticket volume and themes) to identify where customers are experiencing friction and quantify the business impact.
Analyze product and UX data (dashboard usage, onboarding funnels, feature adoption) to find opportunities to improve the customer journey.
Design, build, and maintain robust, well-documented data pipelines and ETL processes that make customer experience data easy to access, trust, and query across the company.
Write and maintain production-quality SQL and pipeline code in Databricks, with work version-controlled and reviewed via GitHub.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve tools that let Product, Engineering, and Support teams monitor customer experience metrics without depending on ad hoc requests.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support/Operations to translate findings into concrete product and process improvements.
Proactively flag emerging issues or trends in payments quality or product experience before they become customer-facing problems.
Continuously improve data quality, documentation, and tooling for your focal area as Bridge's product and scale evolve.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


6+ years of experience as a data analyst or in a similar analytics role, ideally at a payments, fintech, or high-growth technology company.
Excellent SQL skills, with experience querying and modeling data in a modern warehouse/lakehouse environment (e.g., Databricks).
Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL processes, and comfort working with version control (GitHub) as part of a technical workflow.
Strong analytical and diagnostic skills — able to independently investigate a problem, identify root cause, and turn findings into a clear recommendation.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations that communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of a focal area, and manage multiple concurrent priorities with minimal oversight.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical or data-driven findings to non-technical audiences.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience analyzing payments data specifically (transaction quality, uptime/reliability, support ticket trends) or product/UX data (onboarding, dashboard engagement, funnels).
Programming experience (e.g., Python) and familiarity with data manipulation libraries (e.g., pandas).
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment where priorities and scope shift with the business.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $161,600 - $242,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Title: Sr Compliance Data Analyst
Description:
Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

About The Role

Happen Bank’s Compliance Team is looking for an experienced compliance data analytics professional to join the team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining various reports and processes to support the Compliance organization.



What You'll Do



Conduct tuning of existing BSA/AML transaction monitoring models/rules and watchlist screening processes; develop new processes as needed
Execute on initiatives to streamline operational processes related to ad-hoc reporting and ongoing performance monitoring related to BSA/AML and regulatory compliance
Enhance and Develop Community-Reinvestment Act (CRA) reporting to support the strategic plan
Provide support for other Compliance related initiatives and activities as needed, including internal and external audits or regulatory exams and strategic projects; Collaborate with partners across Compliance, Technology, Model Risk Management, and Data Engineering to support deliverables
Perform ongoing User-Acceptance Testing (UAT) to support new products/channels, ensuring coverage in transaction monitoring, customer risk rating, and screening models as required
Use creativity, analytical expertise, and sound judgment to identify and mitigate risk
Use AI tools fluently and stay current on new AI use cases, methods and bring them into your work thoughtfully
Assist in preparing periodic reporting materials for executive leadership
Assist in regulatory exam readiness and internal audit reviews



About You



2-5 years of analytics experience with technical proficiencies in SQL, RStudio, Python, etc.
2+ years of compliance/financial crimes compliance experience in a regulated financial institution with a background in fintech preferred
Knowledge of BSA/AML laws and regulations, including but not limited to the Bank Secrecy Act, the USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC/sanctions requirements, Equal Credit Opportunity Act, the Fair Housing Act, CRA and other laws and regulations related to fair and responsible banking; CAMS or other AML certification is a plus
Experience and inquisitive in the use of AI tools as part of your analytical toolkit — for exploration, pattern recognition, and modeling
Effective communicator who can tailor discussions to various audiences; You have the ability to simplify complex analysis for non-technical audiences
Passion for driving change with an ability to navigate multiple high and sometimes competing priorities
Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity
Bachelor’s degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience


Work Location

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Bobyard

Construction is a trillion dollar industry that still runs on manual work. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings by hand, and it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates so bids get done 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and revenue is doubling quarter over quarter.

About The Role

As our first data hire, you will lay the foundation for our company-wide data architecture and analytics strategy. You will design, build, and maintain our data pipeline and warehousing infrastructure, centralize fragmented data sources, and establish reliable metric definitions across the organization. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional leadership to deliver actionable insights, build high-impact dashboards, and enable data-informed decision-making at every level of the business.

What You'll Do


Architect, scale, and maintain our central data warehouse and scalable ELT/ETL pipelines across internal systems
Design robust data models and data transformation layers to turn raw operational data into clean, production-ready datasets
Establish, document, and standardize core business metrics and KPIs to ensure organizational alignment
Deliver executive- and operational-level reporting, performance tracking, and analytical models for company leadership
Develop intuitive BI dashboards and self-service analytics tools for teams across business operations, product, and strategy
Partner directly with key stakeholders across departments to identify analytical needs and answer strategic business questions
Write clean, efficient, and well-tested SQL and code to automate ingestion, data quality monitoring, and reporting
Implement automated data validation, quality assurance tests, and governance practices as our data ecosystem matures


What We're Looking For


5+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, or business intelligence
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL and hands-on data modeling with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Python for ETL and ELT work — API pulls, scripts, scheduled jobs
You've built a data warehouse and its pipelines from scratch at a company under a few hundred people
Real fluency in a B2B revenue funnel — you know what pipeline, CAC, and net revenue retention mean and why they move
You can define a metric, defend the definition, and get a sales leader to adopt it


Nice to have


BigQuery or a GCP data stack
HubSpot as a source system
Experience building financial or data controls, or supporting a SOC 2 audit
You were the first data hire somewhere before


What We Offer


$140K–$160K base + equity
Medical, dental, and vision, and a 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
The whole data function to build, with the CEO reading what you ship
On-site in SF at 101 Second Street — we build together


Comp Philosophy

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

Compensation Range: $140K - $160K

The Google.org Tech for Social Impact (TSI) team accelerates social impact through technology by providing data infrastructure and tools to nonprofits and civic entities. In this role, you will deliver end-to-end business intelligence projects aligned with Google.org’s Research and Evaluation Strategy. Using your expertise in SQL, data modeling, and BI tools, you will design scalable data structures and maintain ETL pipelines to unify funding records with research findings. You will manage ambiguous problems, such as operationalizing counterfactual models, and enhance our BI infrastructure. Ultimately, you will translate complex impact metrics into clear, actionable dashboards that enable teams and leadership to measure program performance.

Deliver full pieces of Business Intelligence (BI) work integrated into Google.org’s measurement strategy with minimal assistance, exploring the “why” of problems beyond the surface-level ask.
Design data structures, relational schemas, and data models (across business intelligence platform, CRM tooling, and Google.org's harmonized data infrastructure) to store, link, and retrieve longitudinal funding and other data.
Calculate and automate moderately complex impact metrics for all Google.org’s annual and program-specific reporting initiatives using standardized models, external benchmarks, and counterfactual assumptions.
Operationalize pillar metric calculations across Google.org pillar areas including Knowledge, Skills and Learning (KSL), Scientific Progress (SP), Stronger Communities (SC), and Global Programs (GP).

Title: Vice President, Senior Data Analyst - SMA Solutions
Description:
About This Role

Team Overview

BlackRock SMA Solutions helps clients customize portfolios for unique tax, values-alignment, or investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi-asset. We deliver world-class service to all of our clients, from wealth advisors to family offices to endowments and foundations.

About This Role

The Senior SMA Data Analyst is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and operational reliability of client and account data across Salesforce and Entity Master platforms supporting SMA Solutions.

This role sits at the intersection of business operations and technology, requiring a combination of hands-on data analysis, technical proficiency, and strong business judgment. The data analyst will play a critical role in resolving daily data discrepancies that impact account onboarding, servicing, and client workflows, while contributing to long-term data quality and automation initiatives.

The need for this role is driven by a continuous volume of data reconciliation issues that require dedicated ownership to maintain day-to-day business continuity.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and technical skills with business context to support account onboarding, client servicing, operational workflows, and strategic data quality initiatives across SMA Solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Perform manual reconciliation of data discrepancies between CRM and Master Data Management across various client defining objects
Resolve data breaks that impact operational workflows, including onboarding blockers and sync failures
Support the development of automated reconciliation capabilities as part of the broader data quality roadmap
Investigate recurring data issues, including:
Record merges originating from Data Operations Team
Duplicate records and conflicting attributes across systems
Missing or incomplete MDM records
Operationally significant contact conflicts
Conduct root cause analysis and recommend scalable, systemic solutions
Track and monitor ongoing data reconciliation issues and patterns
Develop reporting to quantify issue volume, trends, and business impact
Escalate high-frequency or systemic issues to Salesforce Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Operations teams for resolution
Utilize SQL, SOQL, and Excel to query, analyze, and remediate data across Salesforce and MDM datasets
Perform validation and reconciliation across multiple data sources, including Snowflake where applicable
Develop a strong understanding of business processes, including:
Account onboarding and servicing workflows
Client hierarchy and relationship models
Operationally significant records and dependencies
Apply business context to inform reconciliation decisions and prioritization
Maintain clear documentation of reconciliation processes, issue types, and resolution steps
Build process guides, playbooks, and onboarding materials
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort
Partner cross-functionally across business, data operations, and IT Engineering teams
Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams to drive resolution of data issues


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field
Strong proficiency in SQL, SOQL, Excel, and data analysis techniques
Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM and enterprise data platforms
Familiarity with Snowflake, Power BI, Python, or similar analytical and reporting tools
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and reconciliation processes
Deep familiarity with relational data models, master data concepts, and complex entity relationships
Ability to investigate data issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement scalable solutions
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills


Preferred Qualifications


Experience within the financial services, wealth management, asset management, banking, or brokerage industry
Understanding of advisor, client, account, and corporate hierarchy structures, including intermediary and end-investor relationships
Experience supporting client data, master data, data quality, or reference data management functions
Experience designing or validating automated reconciliation processes and data quality controls

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. Title: Senior Data Analyst - Reconciliation
Description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs' and business owners' financial lives.

Underneath Mercury’s products is a network of banking partners, internal systems, payment rails, and funds flows that enable a powerful, streamlined customer experience. The Financial Data Reconciliation team enables the Mercury system by ensuring end-to-end tracking of transactions across partner banks and internal systems, protecting customer funds through timely, rigorous, and efficient reconciliation. The team owns the full reconciliation lifecycle — from building the data pipelines that transform and enrich transaction data, to matching and investigating exceptions, to reporting on reconciliation health across the business.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Data Reconciliation Analyst who will help operationalize, standardize, and scale reconciliation across Mercury’s banking partners and internal systems. As a senior member of the team, you’ll lead cross-functional initiatives from design through delivery and help other analysts grow. You’ll collaborate with internal and external partners to account for, reconcile, and investigate edge cases in the underlying money movements that power Mercury’s financial products.

You will:


Own the design and implementation of end-to-end reconciliations for new and existing products and funds flows, setting standards that other analysts can build against
Develop and maintain data transformations, enrichment logic, and matching rules that support accurate and scalable reconciliation across internal and external systems
Monitor and investigate reconciliation exceptions, leading root-cause analysis and coordinating with Product, Engineering, Finance, and banking partners to resolve complex breaks and implement durable fixes
Build monitoring, alerting, and reporting that surface reconciliation risks, trends, and improvement opportunities across the team’s portfolio
Define reconciliation requirements and technical specifications for new products and funds flows, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance early in the design process
Partner with Accounting to support month-end close and audit readiness by preparing timely reconciliation analyses, summaries, and supporting documentation
Shape and execute the reconciliation control roadmap, leading cross-functional initiatives and representing the Reconciliation team’s perspective as product coverage and operational complexity grow
Mentor other analysts through hands-on coaching, helping them strengthen their technical and investigative skills


You have:


6+ years of experience working with complex transactional and financial data in fintech or financial services, including areas such as reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, and accounting
Working knowledge of banking payment rails and card networks, such as ACH, wire transfers, RTP, FedNow, Visa, and Mastercard, with an understanding of transaction flows, clearing, settlement, returns, and exception handling
Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience developing and maintaining data transformation pipelines (e.g., dbt or similar)
Strong analytical skills, with a background investigating and resolving complex financial data discrepancies
Familiarity with enterprise reconciliation or matching tools (e.g., Blackline) or similar platforms
Experience building monitoring or BI dashboards to communicate operational and financial metrics using tools such as Omni, Looker, or Tableau
A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and driving alignment across technical and non-technical partners
Experience mentoring or developing other analysts, and a genuine interest in helping others grow
Experience supporting audits, regulatory reporting, or financial-control testing

Title: Staff Business Intelligence Analyst, Resilience
Description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo’s Product Data Science team works cross-functionally with Engineering, Product and Operations to help the company make the most informed decisions using data. Our team collaborates on high-impact projects across the company — from driving quality and operational efficiency to market analysis and rider satisfaction scores — we help to safely and efficiently scale the Waymo Driver. We are data-driven, curious, open-minded, and adapt quickly to new information.

In this hybrid role, you will report to the Product Data Science Lead, Supply Operations.

You Will


Define, build, and maintain KPIs and metrics to measure operational safety and quality across our Operations Center
Architect and scale data infrastructure to support automated reporting for Road Rule Events, improving operational transparency and safety insights
Quantify our operational capacity to handle events, providing actionable data to scale team performance and optimize response protocols
Analyze agent response precision to identify performance patterns, optimize workflows, and provide input for AI model training
Partner cross-functionally to translate business challenges into robust data pipelines and reporting solutions that drive operational resilience


You Have


8+ years of experience in a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience), with a proven track record of architecting and scaling projects
Excellent communication and Stakeholder & Management skills: You can communicate clearly complex topic in an easy to understand way to stakeholders at all levels of the company
Extensive experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Action Oriented Analytical mindset - you not only build the report, you look at your data and make actionable recommendations from it


We Prefer


Experience in the Autonomous Vehicle industry or a strong background in engineering or physics
Experience working with Operations

$200,000—$247,000 USD

Title: Business Partner Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Strategy & Analytics (S&A) maximizes and accelerates Operations' ability to make Stripe work for our users. We aspire to be the COOs for Stripe Ops, working cross-functionally with global teams to help run the day-to-day business and articulate and achieve the longer term, high effort, high value strategic priorities. We take a data-driven approach that combines strategy and analytics to help Ops leaders solve their most complex and most important issues while also driving the business planning and operational cadence end-to-end, from strategy to goal-setting to execution.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for your business area. You’ll be hands-on and responsible for delivering critical insights, ensuring data driven decision making is at the core of what we do. You’ll also partner with leadership to drive business strategy, planning, goal-setting and performance tracking. You may also scope and lead mission critical projects and execute on strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities


Metrics & Insights: Wrangle large, highly complex datasets using SQL into actionable insights and become the data expert for your business area. Develop metrics and large-scale dashboards to track the health of our user-facing and internal teams. Perform analyses (using SQL & other analytical tools/languages), identify trends, conduct research, build models, all to deliver objective, critical insights that can inform leadership of opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities.
Communicate with executives: Create narratives and documents that tell the story of your business area to influence senior Operations leadership and Stripe executive team decision making
Stakeholder management: Influence and drive cross-functional change by partnering with stakeholders across a wide internal network of globally distributed teams, including Ops, Finance, Data Science, Product/Engineering, and more
Drive operational excellence: Design, optimize and drive operational reviews and rhythm of the business. Guide the planning and goal-setting process for your business area, as well as progress checks throughout the year. Bring and consistently apply a ROI lens to all operational decisions, so we can make better-informed trade-offs
Support planning: support with forecasting/planning processes for Financial Crimes, including near/medium/long-term planning, to enable leadership to make strategic decisions



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


5+ years of prior experience in analytical and strategic roles in management consulting, Operations, Support, Risk or Financial Services
Outstanding analytical ability, expert in SQL and understanding of data relationships
Outstanding communication, presentation skills & stakeholder management skills
Experience working in or with Operations, Support, Risk, Trust & Safety, Financial Crimes, or Financial Services
Expertise working cross-functionally and with globally distributed teams to drive business and operational goals using data
Ability to connect the big picture to minute details, toggling between them to set and operationalize strategy



Preferred Qualifications


* Experience working in fast-paced environments (e.g. high-growth internet or software company, management consulting)
Structured problem solving skills, combined with strong business acumen.
Experience with Tableau

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $112,700 - $169,100. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact

Title: Analyst, Strategic Finance and Reporting (Remote)
Description:
Employer.com is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Analyst, Strategic Finance and Reporting to support key strategic initiatives through actionable insights, reliable forecasting, and deep analytical work. This role plays a critical part in driving business growth and cost efficiency by delivering accurate revenue, expense, and churn forecasts.

In this role, you’ll work closely with cross-functional partners across Sales, Marketing, Finance, People Operations, and Operations to ensure the accuracy and integrity of customer and revenue data. You’ll leverage tools such as Salesforce, SQL, and Excel/Google Sheets to build, maintain, and optimize revenue and performance reporting, while identifying and explaining budget-to-actual variances.

If you thrive in fast-paced, data-driven environments and enjoy working at the intersection of analytics, forecasting, and business strategy, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Job Description

Revenue & Churn Forecasting


Build, refine, and maintain revenue and churn forecasting models, adapting them based on market conditions, business needs, and evolving data trends
Continuously improve forecasting methodologies to enhance accuracy and predictability
Conduct variance analysis between forecasts and actuals, and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders


Data Integration & Analytics


Integrate data from Salesforce, Redshift, Tableau, and other sources to ensure reliable inputs for forecasting and reporting
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to gather, validate, and align data for decision-making
Perform deep-dive analyses to uncover trends, anomalies, and root causes


Reporting & Decision Support


Develop and maintain dashboards and reports tracking GTM KPIs, sales performance, and revenue and cost trends (e.g., ARPU, Gross Margin, LTV, headcount costs, OpEx)
Present key insights, forecasts, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
Support budgeting, goal-setting, and revenue growth initiatives through data-driven guidance


Process Optimization & Data Quality


Maintain high standards for data accuracy, governance, and integrity across reporting and analytics
Identify opportunities to streamline reporting, automate workflows, and improve analytical efficiency
Act as a subject matter expert in forecasting methodologies, reporting best practices, and analytics tools

2–4 years of experience in Go-to-Market Analytics, Sales Forecasting, or Sales Performance & Reporting, ideally within a SaaS environment

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to communicate complex insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on


Things We Consider a Plus


Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment


Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $150,000-$160,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:


Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
Fully-paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
Work from home setup allowance
Access to your earnings every day on Clair
Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance


Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For questions, please email us at careers@getclair.com
