Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

The Analyst II, Data Analysis will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets to derive actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role requires a skilled data analyst with strong analytical abilities, a deep understanding of statistical methods, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in data analysis, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for leveraging data to drive business outcomes.

What You’ll Do


Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Develop and implement statistical models and algorithms to solve business problems.
Validate and refine models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Create clear and compelling data visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders.
Prepare and present regular reports on data analysis outcomes to senior leadership.
Develop dashboards and other tools to enable self-service data access for business users.
Collect, clean, and preprocess data from various sources to ensure data quality and consistency.
Collaborate with data engineers and IT teams to design and implement data pipelines and workflows.
Ensure data is properly stored, organized, and accessible for analysis.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, and finance, to support data-driven decision-making.
Provide training and support to team members on data analysis and visualization best practices.
Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analysis.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement innovative solutions.
Attends company training and regional training in area of expertise. Presents own work to members of department.


What You’ll Bring To Zelis


Typically has Bach. +2-3 yrs; Masters +0 yrs
Requires proficiency using AI tools skillfully with an understanding of how to develop/create intelligent prompts and/or agents.
Fluency with data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Excel).
Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
Healthcare claims editing experience a plus.
Understanding of statistics and data modeling preferred.
Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Experience presenting findings to senior leadership team
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) is a plus.
Knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Certification in data analysis or related fields.


Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Location and Workplace Flexibility

Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.

While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

Base Salary Range

$71,000.00 - $90,250.00

At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job-related and industry-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role.

Zelis’ full-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all.

Accessibility Support

We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email TalentAcquisition@zelis.com.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

Title: Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst
Description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst to provide sustained, hands-on analytical capacity for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. The role develops baselines, recurring metrics, validated calculations, dashboards, data-quality checks, and outcome evidence that help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.

This position follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately 25% onsite presence at LMI’s Tysons headquarters or Washington, DC.

The Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst provides the recurring analytical backbone needed to turn agreed definitions into reliable evidence. The role is responsible for making sure metrics can be reproduced, reconciled, explained, and refreshed consistently rather than producing one-time analyses that are difficult to sustain.

The ideal candidate is detail- oriented but outcome focused. The analyst should be able to move from source data through cleaning, transformation, calculation, visualization, and narrative interpretation while maintaining a clear audit trail of definitions, assumptions, filters, denominators, and known data limitations.

The role depends heavily on stakeholder trust. The analyst should be able to explain why numbers changed, where a discrepancy came from, and what a measure actually represents . Strong candidates will not treat dashboard production as the end goal; they will focus on creating measures that stakeholders can understand and use consistently.

The ideal candidate is a strong execution analyst who can turn messy operational data into clear, traceable metrics and communicate what the numbers do - and do not - support.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities


Prepare, clean, combine, transform, and validate data from multiple sources.
Calculate baselines, recurring metrics, before/after measures, denominators, and outcome indicators.
Build analytical tables, visualizations, dashboards, and decision-ready reporting products.
Document metric definitions, data sources, cadence, validation steps, assumptions, and calculation logic.
Perform data-quality checks, reconcile discrepancies, and maintain reproducible analytical workflows.
Support outcome reports with validated findings, concise narrative, and clear limitations.
Respond to recurring and ad-hoc analytical questions for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Escalate data-quality, access, or methodology concerns that could materially affect conclusions.
Develop and maintain metric dictionaries that define business rules, source fields, exclusions, denominators, refresh cadence, validation steps, owners, and interpretation guidance.
Automate repeatable data-preparation, quality-check, calculation, and reporting steps where practical to reduce manual effort and improve consistency over time.
Reconcile discrepancies across source systems, reports, and stakeholder calculations and document the resolution when definitions or authoritative sources differ.
Support ad-hoc analytical questions by quickly profiling data, testing hypotheses, and translating results into concise findings while preserving reproducibility.
Work with stakeholders to translate reporting needs into precise metric definitions, data requirements, calculation rules, validation checks, and acceptance criteria before building recurring products.
Perform periodic quality reviews of dashboards and recurring reports to identify stale logic, broken refreshes, source changes, unexpected trends, or definition drift that could undermine confidence in the results.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, public health, information systems, business analytics, or a related field.
4+ years in data analysis, reporting, performance measurement, business intelligence, or related work.
Strong SQL plus at least one analytical tool such as Python, R, SAS, or advanced Excel.
Experience with data preparation, validation, dashboards, recurring metrics, and documentation of assumptions/limitations.
Recommended certification: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst or comparable BI/data-analytics credential.
Ability to satisfy VA personnel vetting and applicable security, privacy, records, and data-handling requirements.
Demonstrated ability to build reliable recurring analyses from imperfect operational data, including validation, reconciliation, exception handling, and documentation of assumptions.
Strong practical skills with SQL, Excel and/or Python/R plus a visualization tool, with enough technical depth to trace a metric from dashboard output back to source data and calculation logic.
Clear analytical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain definitions, data-quality concerns, limitations, and changes in results to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience eliciting and documenting reporting requirements, metric definitions, business rules, and acceptance criteria with business or mission stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple recurring and ad-hoc analytical requests, prioritize based on decision need and effort, and communicate realistic timelines when data access or quality is a constraint.


Desired Qualifications


6+ years supporting federal, healthcare, operational, implementation, utilization , or outcome measurement.
Experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, SQL Server, Azure data tools, or similar enterprise analytics platforms.
Experience supporting pilot measurement, program evaluation, before/after analysis, or clinical/operational metrics.
Additional SQL, cloud analytics, data visualization, or Lean Six Sigma certification is preferred.
Experience with Power BI semantic models, DAX, Power Query, SQL Server, automated refresh, data quality monitoring, or controlled reporting environments is preferred.
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, data analytics, SQL, or comparable business-intelligence certification is valuable.
Experience supporting executive dashboards, operational performance reviews, benefits measurement, or program-evaluation reporting in a federal or healthcare environment is preferred.
Exposure to governed semantic models, certified datasets, data catalogs, lineage tools, or enterprise reporting standards is beneficial.


Target salary range: $135,000-$160,000

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our growing team and play a key role in driving data informed decision making across the organization. This individual will lead complex analytics initiatives from problem definition through delivery, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable insights and data driven solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in SQL, Python, data visualization, and data analysis with the business acumen and communication skills needed to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is a hands-on role for someone who can independently manage analytics projects, identify meaningful trends and opportunities within data, and communicate findings that influence business decisions.

What You’ll Do


Lead complex data analysis initiatives, taking ownership of assignments from initial requirements gathering and problem definition through analysis, mapping, documentation, and delivery.
Partner directly with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs and translate requirements into detailed technical mappings and specifications.
Perform comprehensive source-to-target data analysis and mapping, including data profiling, validation, transformation requirements, and identification of data quality issues.
Query and analyze large, complex datasets using SQL to identify relationships, trends, anomalies, and business rules and support data-driven solutions.
Apply strong data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables, to support enterprise data initiatives.
Develop and maintain clear data documentation while supporting data governance standards, data quality, and integrity across assigned projects.
Collaborate closely with data engineers, data architects, analysts, and business users while developing domain expertise and providing guidance and mentorship to junior analysts.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analysis and data warehousing, including experience supporting complex enterprise data projects.
Strong experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, Data Analysis, Data Mapping, and Data Warehousing.
Strong hands-on SQL expertise with demonstrated experience performing complex data analysis, data profiling, and source-to-target data mapping.
Strong understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables.
Demonstrated ability to independently analyze source data, work through ambiguous requirements, and partner with business and development teams to translate business requirements into technical mappings and data solutions.

At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Our continued success is built on a culture of collaboration, innovation, client service, and mutual respect. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees are empowered to grow their careers, contribute meaningfully, and thrive professionally.

 

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.

Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
Tableau, or Excel.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
actionable insights.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
processes.
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.


Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence tools.

Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline


Experience


5 years of related experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Decision Intelligence, Research, Learning Science, or Behavioral/Cognitive Psychology.

This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Description:
À propos de Highspring

Highspring est une firme de consultation et de services professionnels de nouvelle génération. Nous accompagnons des organisations partout en Amérique du Nord dans leurs initiatives de transformation, de modernisation technologique et d'innovation.

Nous collaborons avec des organisations de premier plan, notamment dans les secteurs bancaire, de l'assurance et des technologies, afin de concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions modernes ayant un impact concret.

Chez Highspring, nous valorisons l'excellence technique, la collaboration, l'apprentissage continu et le développement de nos talents.

L'opportunité

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Data Analyst pour rejoindre une équipe travaillant sur des projets data d'envergure à Montréal.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable d'analyser, de transformer et de valoriser les données afin de générer des insights d'affaires concrets et de soutenir la prise de décision. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes techniques et d'affaires afin de comprendre les besoins, développer des analyses pertinentes et contribuer à l'évolution des solutions data.

Une bonne maîtrise de SQL et des services AWS est essentielle pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Localisation : Montréal, QC

Mode de travail : Hybride

Langues : Français et anglais - bilinguisme requis

Ce que vous ferez

Analyser de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, anomalies et opportunités.
Transformer les besoins d'affaires en analyses et solutions data concrètes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL complexes.
Travailler avec les services AWS afin d'extraire, traiter et analyser les données.
Participer à la conception et à l'évolution des processus de collecte, transformation et consommation des données.
Développer et maintenir des rapports, dashboards et indicateurs de performance.
Transformer les résultats d'analyse en recommandations et insights actionnables pour les équipes d'affaires.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, développement, produit et les parties prenantes d'affaires.
Effectuer la validation, le nettoyage et le contrôle de la qualité des données.
Identifier les problèmes liés aux données et contribuer à leur résolution.
Documenter les analyses, les processus et les indicateurs développés.
Participer à des projets d'amélioration continue et de modernisation des solutions data.
Évoluer dans un environnement Agile et collaboratif.

Ce que vous apportez

3 à 5+ années d'expérience en Data Analytics ou dans un rôle similaire.
Excellente maîtrise de SQL.
Expérience pratique avec AWS, notamment avec certains des services suivants :
Amazon S3
Amazon Athena
Amazon Redshift
AWS Glue
Expérience avec des outils de BI et de visualisation, tels que :
Power BI
Tableau
ou outils similaires.
Expérience dans l'analyse de données et la production de business insights.
Bonne compréhension des bases de données relationnelles et des concepts de data warehousing.
Expérience avec Python est un atout.
Excellentes capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.
Capacité à communiquer des résultats techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Expérience dans un environnement Agile.
Français et anglais professionnels.




Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst, capable d'aller au-delà de la production de rapports et de transformer les données en recommandations concrètes.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec SQL, AWS et les outils de visualisation, vous aimez comprendre les problématiques d'affaires et vous savez communiquer clairement vos conclusions à différents types de parties prenantes.

Vous êtes également curieux(se), analytique et à l'aise dans des environnements où les priorités évoluent rapidement.

Pourquoi joindre Highspring ?

Travailler sur des projets data d'envergure.
Évoluer dans des environnements utilisant des technologies cloud modernes.
Développer votre expertise sur AWS et les plateformes data.
Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et des experts techniques.
Participer à des initiatives de transformation et de modernisation.
Profiter d'occasions continues d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement.
Faire partie d'une culture collaborative axée sur l'excellence technique et le partage des connaissances.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with


Confido provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compensation Range: $175K - $210K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Gaming)
Description:
Join our dynamic and innovative gaming company, passionate about creating immersive and cutting-edge gaming experiences. We pride ourselves on a culture of creativity, collaboration, and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of gaming. If you're a highly motivated and skilled specialist passionate about the gaming industry, we want you to join our team. This is a full-time IN-OFFICE position in Vaughan.

The System Data Analyst will be in a critical position driving data-driven decision-making, optimizing business performance, and shaping the strategic direction of the gaming brands role within the company!

1. Economy and Metrics Insight
• Analyze game economies and metrics to understand their interdependencies and drive data-informed decisions.
• Develop models to forecast the impact of changes on player behavior, retention, and revenue.

• Analyze large datasets to uncover actionable trends in player behavior and game performance.

5. Product Development Support
• Provide recommendations to enhance game features and in-game economies based on analytical findings.

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, or another quantitative field.

3-5+ years in similar analytical roles in the social casino/iGaming industry.

Proficient in SQL and experience with complex data queries.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex data into actionable insights.

Passion for the social gaming industry and an adaptable attitude.

Personal values - Pro-activeness, assertiveness, goals and not tasks driven self-management.

Experience with PowerBI

Previous supervisory/managerial experience

Collaborative and supportive work environment

Competitive salary and bonuses

Opportunities for career development, growth and advancement

On-site leisure facilities

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team. The Data Analyst is a key contributor to the product development of Sentia’s agentic behavioral health platform, utilizing a strong data-driven approach. This role involves seamlessly collaborating with various technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate data insights into actionable strategies and communicating the underlying data narrative to non-technical audiences. This analyst will be crucial in the initial setup and architecture of the data warehouse, establishing the foundation for all data operations.

Key responsibilities include collecting requirements, querying databases, and developing dashboards and reports for both internal business stakeholders and external partners. The analyst excels in both qualitative and quantitative data analysis, identifying trends and surfacing crucial insights that lead to informed decision-making, and also excels in consumer product analysis.To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based in Eastern Hours. Talkspace Headquarters in NYC.

What You’ll Do


Data Visualization and Reporting
Develop and refine data visualizations that clearly communicate outcomes, network performance, and user engagement trends to stakeholders.
Create automated quality reports and network performance dashboards using Looker and other tools.
Deeply understand and analyze user pathways, business outcomes, and the dynamics of our provider/partner network.
Quantitative Analysis
Conduct thorough quantitative analyses to support business strategies.
Utilize your expertise in SQL and Python to manage business and provider data effectively.
Strategic Insights
Collaborate with business, finance, marketing and cross-functional teams to provide data-driven insights supporting product development and provider network operations.
Navigate the intricacies of a multi-sided marketplace, understanding different stakeholder needs and market drivers.
Communication and Collaboration
Engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform complex data insights into understandable and actionable strategies for enhancing customer service and provider engagement.
Work closely with a seasoned Data Science team to leverage advanced analytics in shaping business and network intelligence strategies.
Create and present easily digestible and actionable recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decision-making processes.
Data Modeling and Pipeline Management Design
Build, and maintain robust, documented, and scalable data models (e.g., using dbt) within the data warehouse to support downstream reporting and analytical needs.
Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize data ingestion processes (ETL/ELT) and ensure the timely availability of high-quality data.
Analyze agentic platform performance metrics
Metrics include model accuracy, latency, conversation depth, and user adherence to behavioral protocols.

About You


3-5 years of experience in an analytical role, experience with healthcare data (patient outcomes, capacity planning, etc.) a plus.
BA/BS in a quantitative field like statistics, applied mathematics, economics, computer science, or equivalent experience.
Proficiency in SQL, python, and Excel / Google Sheets.
Comfortable with statistics and data manipulation.
Advanced skills in data visualization tools like Looker or Tableau are essential.
Experience with product analytics tools like Mixpanel.
Experience with leveraging GenAI tools is a plus.


Benefits


Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage
Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!


Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $110,000 and $130,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
  • Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
  • Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
  • Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
  • Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
  • Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
  • Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
  • Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience working in data analysis
  • Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
  • Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
  • Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
  • Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
  • Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with R
  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience with HR data and training development
  • Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
  • Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
  • Possession of excellent communication skills


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

On highways, construction sites, city streets, logging roads - everywhere our customers earn their living - Peterbilt's red oval is a familiar symbol of performance, reliability and pride. Our dedication to deliver products and services focused on improving customers' performance, image, profitability and peace of mind truly makes Peterbilt the Class of the Industry.

Requisition Summary

Peterbilt has an immediate need for a talented and self-motivated Data Analyst. This position will support the AfterSales Department with reporting and in-depth data analysis. This role reports to the Data Analytics Manager, AfterSales.

Job Responsibilities


Extract, clean, merge, transform and compile data from various data sources, including relational databases, flat files, NoSQL databases and unstructured data using Python and SQL.
Create and implement dashboards and reports in Tableau to share metrics and insights with team members and senior executives.
Integrate AfterSales data from multiple sources to produce a single overarching view of the customer AfterSales experience.
Monthly General Manager Warranty Meetings Data Extraction and query updates.
Develop and implement analytical model that provide actionable insights to support cross functional team objectives.
Provide accurate, relevant, and meaningful ad-hoc analysis to management to support strategic and tactical decision-making.
Develop new process improvements to increase the speed, accuracy, and efficiency of our work.
Create and present materials on data projects.

Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related field
7+ years of applicable job experience, with a proven ability to make process improvements
Experience in creating executive/summary level dashboards and reports, integrating many data sources
Experience with Snowflake and Python
Strong understanding of advanced Tableau features and capabilities


Preferred Qualifications


Must be a highly motivated self-starter and self-directed learner with a creative mind, high attention to detail and a solution-oriented outlook
Candidate must demonstrate strong analytical skills, critical thinking, excellent general business acumen, with the ability to communicate complex topics concisely and clearly
Demonstrable in-depth understanding of data structures and ETL processes
Familiarity with cloud storage like AWS
GitHub experience for version control

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability
