Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support


Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.


Program Performance Analytics


Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.


Requirements

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the healthcare industry.
Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms.


Personal Attributes


Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.


What Success Looks Like


The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems; you will be expected to communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Dive into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth

Communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Requirements

3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills including abnormality detection, predictive analysis, market segmentation, and competitive analysis.
Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required

Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC’s Advanced Energy Strategic Deployment team is seeking a Data Analyst II to support data management, analysis, and reporting across strategic projects that advance the energy sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing metrics and building reports for a variety of projects, with the knowledge and expertise to create, edit, and modify data sets and produce accurate, timely, and clear analytics for the team and our clients.

The ideal candidate is an independent, detail-oriented contributor with a positive attitude who excels at multitasking while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, efficiency, and reliability. They will bring curiosity about emerging tools—including AI—and a desire to apply data analytics, visualization, and geospatial techniques to real-world advanced energy challenges. A sufficient understanding of the energy industry to interpret the data required for the position is preferred.

Why Consider This Job Opportunity?


Advance your career through ongoing learning and development
Maintain a healthy work-life balance with supportive policies
Collaborate within an inclusive and respectful team environment
Contribute to a rapidly expanding and future-focused industry
Support impactful projects driving the clean energy transition


Responsibilities


Provide valuable insight to program teams based on the data collected, enabling informed decision-making.
Build and maintain customized dashboards and reporting for clients, subcontractors, management, and cross-functional team members in our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database.
Sort through and interpret high quantities of data, identifying, diagnosing, and correcting discrepancies to ensure accuracy.
Develop data models through reporting and visualization to support decision-making.
Monitor and report program key performance metrics and provide updates to management.
Support program platform tasks, including configuration, dashboards, and data import/export as directed.
Provide input for troubleshooting, process improvements, automation, and system enhancements.
Research and present market intelligence and customer trends to support strategic advanced energy projects.
Explore and pilot AI-enabled and geospatial (GIS) approaches to streamline data-intensive processes and enhance analysis.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Geography/GIS, Engineering, Environmental Studies, a related field, or equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience performing data analysis and using tools to create reports, dashboards, and data exploration.
Residency in the Denver, Colorado area preferred.
Advanced computer skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams); advanced Excel skills preferred.
Experience with data analysis and visualization software (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Tableau, R, or Python).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong time-management skills, and attention to detail.
Ability to contribute to multiple projects simultaneously with demonstrated accuracy and reliability.
Experience applying AI / machine-learning tools to data analysis, automation, or reporting.
Strong Power BI development skills (data modeling, DAX, interactive dashboards).
Microsoft Enterprise ecosystem experience, including Microsoft Dynamics (a plus), Power Platform, and SharePoint.
ArcGIS / Esri experience for spatial data creation, analysis, and visualization.
Additional data analytics skills such as SQL, Python, R, or data-pipeline/API integration.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, and self-direct across many concurrent stretch assignments in a high-paced, high-accountability environment with minimal oversight.
Strong interest or experience supporting projects in the energy space, such as energy efficiency (EE), demand response (DR), distributed energy resource management systems (DERMS), or similar utility/clean-energy projects.


Benefits*: TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:


Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.
TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence.
These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees.


Compensation: In accordance with local law, the below salary range is applicable for the job and location associated with this requisition. Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors.

Other Compensation: Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee.

Disclaimers

TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

Salary Range

USD $70,586.88 - USD $85,000.00 /Yr.

Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.

***This role is based in Sandy Springs, GA and offers a HYBRID work schedule.***

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

The role sits at the intersection of data engineering and business analytics - building reliable, well-modeled data assets and turning them into analyses that drive product, growth, and operations decisions.

The Data Analyst will work closely with analytics engineers, data engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to define metrics, instrument them correctly, and ship dashboards and analyses that leadership actually uses. The role matters because decisions at the company are made on data, and this is one of the people accountable for making that data trustworthy.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain metrics layers and semantic models in dbt, ensuring consistent definitions across dashboards and ad-hoc analyses
Write performant SQL against a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to answer product, growth, and operational questions
Build and maintain dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Mode for leadership and cross-functional partners, with documented metric definitions
Own end-to-end analyses - cohort retention, funnel conversion, A/B test readouts, unit economics - from framing through presentation
Partner with data engineers on data quality: set up monitoring, validate dbt model outputs, and triage pipeline anomalies
Translate ambiguous stakeholder requests into clear analytical questions, deliverables, and timelines
Document analyses, metric definitions, and methodologies so findings are reproducible and auditable


What We Are Looking For


3-6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering
Expert-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy) for analysis and data manipulation
Hands-on experience with dbt and a modern data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
Track record of shipping dashboards and self-serve analytics in Looker, Tableau, or Mode
Solid statistics fundamentals: hypothesis testing, regression, experiment analysis, and common analytical pitfalls
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, engineering) or equivalent practical experience
Bonus: experience with data visualization libraries (Plotly, Streamlit), reverse ETL tools, event tracking design (Segment, Amplitude), or owning an A/B testing program

Description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The Work:

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in the application migration team by leveraging data to drive informed decision-making throughout the migration process. This position is responsible for compiling and analyzing complex datasets, maintaining comprehensive reports, and presenting actionable insights to stakeholders. The Senior Data Analyst works within Agile frameworks to support the team's data-driven approach to application assessment, migration planning, and post-migration evaluation.

Key Responsibilities


Collect and consolidate data from various sources related to application performance, usage, and migration progress
Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across all datasets
Conduct in-depth analysis of application data to identify patterns, trends, and potential issues
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making in the migration process
Design and create comprehensive reports on various aspects of the migration project
Develop dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate complex data insights
Maintain and update regular reports on migration progress, performance metrics, and KPIs
Create compelling visual representations of data findings using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Develop and deliver presentations on migration analytics to various levels of the organization
Conduct pre- and post-migration comparisons to evaluate the success of migration efforts
Provide data-driven insights to support decision-making at all levels of the project
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for the migration project
Develop metrics to measure the success and efficiency of the migration process
Create and maintain scorecards to track progress against project goals
Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives)
Collaborate with Product Owners to define and refine data-related user stories


Requirements:


Bachelors degree and minimum 5 years experience
Secret Security Clerance required

Description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University

Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community.

Description

About Winship Cancer Institute of Emory University

Dedicated to discovering cures for cancer and inspiring hope, Winship Cancer Institute of Emory University is Georgia’s only National Cancer Institute-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, a prestigious distinction given to the top tier of cancer centers nationwide for making breakthroughs against cancer. Winship is researching, developing, teaching, and providing novel and highly effective ways to prevent, detect, diagnose, treat, and survive cancer. Cancer care at Winship includes leading cancer specialists collaborating across disciplines to tailor treatment plans to each patient’s needs and type of cancer; innovative therapies and clinical trials; comprehensive patient and family support services; and a personalized care experience aimed at easing the burden of cancer. Winship is Where Science Becomes Hope®. For more information, visit winshipcancer.emory.edu.

Winship is seeking qualified candidates for the Data Analyst, Senior position. Position details are as follows:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Supports the acquisition, management and analysis of data from multiple sites or sources.
Supports the configuration and management of technology solutions supporting the receipt, transformation, validation and storage of data.
Ensures that the uses of data through reports and queries are appropriate.
Serves as an organizational consultant on matters relating to databases by providing expertise to assist users in meeting their needs.
Develops automated quality control procedures to assess quality of data and provides reports to data owners.
Works effectively within a group setting in areas of design of data collection instruments, database management, analysis of data, and creation of reports and dashboards.
Develops and performs appropriate analyses.
Provides explanations of analysis methods, assumptions made, and assists in interpretation of results and implications therein.
Documents methods and results through development and maintenance of standard documentation artifacts including data dictionaries, standard operating procedures and analysis methodology descriptions.
Works with onsite or field-based counterparts to coordinate consistent implementation of data quality control measures and provision of access to the central data repositories.
Performs related responsibilities as assigned.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:


A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, and three years of experience in processes and standards related to data, OR an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Experience with relational database management systems such as, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL preferred.
Experience with statistical packages such as, SAS, SPSS, R preferred.

Definir métricas, KPIs y estructuras de reporting junto a equipos de negocio.

Traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas escalables.

Proponer mejoras funcionales, analíticas y técnicas de manera proactiva.
Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar procesos de desarrollo y análisis.

Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años como Data Analyst o roles similares.
Experiencia demostrable en modelado de datos (dimensional, analítico o reporting).

Diseño de dashboards.
Modelado semántico.
Definición de KPIs y métricas.
Desarrollo con DAX.

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de modelos en LookML.
Creación de Explores y vistas.
Desarrollo de cuadros de mando y reporting.
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL para explotación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes y stakeholders de negocio.
Capacidad para comunicar resultados y presentar soluciones analíticas.
Perfil autónomo, proactivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas.
Capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.

💼 Contrato indefinido en una compañía puramente tecnológica, que forma parte de un gran grupo, solvente y en crecimiento.

Qui sommes-nous ?



Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.



Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.





Description du poste



NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Power BI / GCP H/F, en CDI, à Paris !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur bancaire.



Tes missions :



Identifier, extraire et collecter des données provenant de différentes sources (bases de données, systèmes internes, API externes, etc.).
Effectuer des analyses statistiques et quantitatives pour comprendre les tendances et identifier les opportunités d'optimisation.
Créer des rapports et des dashboards interactifs à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI afin de communiquer les résultats de manière claire et compréhensible.
Assurer la qualité des données en les nettoyant et en les structurant pour les rendre exploitables.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes décisionnelles pour les aider à interpréter les données et prendre des décisions informées.
Automatiser les processus d’analyse et de reporting via des scripts ou des outils spécialisés
Se tenir informé des nouvelles méthodes et outils d'analyse de données pour optimiser les processus existants.







Qualifications



De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu possèdes au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Agile/SCRUM.



Tu as une excellente capacité à développer et documenter tes analyses (data sourcing, hypothèses et méthodes analytiques) dans une logique Lean & Agile.



Tu as une forte expérience en préparation de données (Big Query, PowerBI) en particulier sur une modern data stack.



Tu maîtrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.





Informations supplémentaires



Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ?



Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :



▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours.



▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences.



▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser.



▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir.



▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce.



▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté.



Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous !

Title: Senior Data Analist Kruidvat
Description:
Dit ga je doen

In de rol van Senior Data Analist bij AS Watson ben je onderdeel van het Decision Analytics‑team binnen Data, Insights & Analytics voor onze merken Kruidvat en Trekpleister. Samen met andere collega's uit het analytics team (Data Engineer, Data Scientist) werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten en analyses die meerdere businessdomeinen raken, van commercie tot HR en supply chain tot winkels.

Als grootste Health en Beauty retailer in de Benelux hebben we een schat aan data die we kunnen gebruiken. Elke week worden we bezocht door 4 MILJOEN klanten in onze ruim 1500 winkels én webshops. Zowel in de Benelux als internationaal hebben we de focus op data analytics. Dit zie je onder andere terug in de centrale rol van onze afdeling en investeringen in moderne data en Cloud technologieën. Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

Wat ga je doen als Data Analist bij AS Watson?


Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.
Je vertaalt de (interne) klantvragen naar technische requirements of een helder analysevraagstuk.
Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.


Dit krijg je ervoor terug


Een snelle omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren. En werkplezier door verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de ruimte om jezelf te ontplooien. 
Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.


Dit ben jij


Je brengt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Analist of BI Consultant mee en beweegt je moeiteloos tussen verschillende businessdomeinen; je combineert analytische vaardigheden met een pragmatische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak om het datagedreven werken verder te versterken.
Je bent bedreven in het opstellen van meetplannen, het definiëren en het visualiseren van de juiste KPI’s en het is een pre als je zelf dashboards kan ontwerpen (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio of vergelijkbaar).
Je beheerst SQL uitstekend, kunt goed uit de voeten met statistische analyses en voelt je thuis in cloud‑based (analytics) platforms zoals Databricks, Google Cloud Console of Microsoft Azure. Kennis van Python is een pre.
Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en naar de onderliggende dynamiek van verschillende businessdomeinen (commercie, supply chain, operatie, HR, finance, enz.)
Je bent in staat om de inzichten van je analyses op een heldere en simpele manier over te brengen aan collega's. Wel zo handig als je in crossfunctionele teams werkt.


Wie jij bent, maakt ons buitengewoon! Waar wacht je nog op? Solliciteer snel en laat van je horen!

Bureaus leg de telefoon maar weer neer: wij werven zelf voor deze vacature.

  • 24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
  • Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
  • Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.

  • Je brengt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Analist of BI Consultant mee en beweegt je moeiteloos tussen verschillende businessdomeinen; je combineert analytische vaardigheden met een pragmatische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak om het datagedreven werken verder te versterken.
  • Je bent bedreven in het opstellen van meetplannen, het definiëren en het visualiseren van de juiste KPI’s en het is een pre als je zelf dashboards kan ontwerpen (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio of vergelijkbaar).
  • Je beheerst SQL uitstekend, kunt goed uit de voeten met statistische analyses en voelt je thuis in cloud‑based (analytics) platforms zoals Databricks, Google Cloud Console of Microsoft Azure. Kennis van Python is een pre.
  • Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en naar de onderliggende dynamiek van verschillende businessdomeinen (commercie, supply chain, operatie, HR, finance, enz.)

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job title: DATA ANALYST

Location: Paris, France

Job reference #: 33732

Contract type: Permanent

Language requirements: Fluent in French and English




At Eni, we are looking for a Data Analyst to join Eni Plenitude France. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Finance, Sales, Operations and Customer Service, to transform data into actionable insights that drive business performance. You will play a key role in analysing, interpreting and enhancing data to support commercial growth, optimise the customer experience, address business needs and enable strategic decision-making, ultimately contributing to the company’s operational efficiency and long-term success.




About Plenitude




Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This partnership represents a major European project integrating the renewable energy business with the retail business, which will enable us to progressively increase our offering of services, infrastructure, and green energy for our customers, providing our team with greater visibility and professional growth.




Main Responsibilities




Data Collection and Processing: Extract, transform and structure data from a variety of internal and external sources.
Data Analysis: Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify trends, customer behaviours and performance drivers.
Data Visualisation and Reporting: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI) and establish and monitor business KPIs.
Advanced Analytics: Contribute to the development of models, forecasts and predictive analyses.
Optimisation and Recommendations: Provide actionable insights to improve processes, marketing campaigns and the customer experience.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical teams, including IT, developers and data scientists, while partnering with business departments to understand analytical needs and business objectives.
Data Culture: Promote data-driven decision-making and support internal teams in the effective use of data and KPI management.




Skills And Experience Required




Bachelor's or Master's degree (BSc/MSc) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
Proficiency in data visualisation tools, particularly Power BI.
Good knowledge of data analysis languages and tools, including SQL, Python and R.
Experience with Big Data and/or Cloud environments (Azure, Google Cloud Platform or AWS) would be an advantage.
Significant experience in data analysis.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, meaningful and impactful insights for different audiences.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across multiple functions.
Well-organised, self-motivated and capable of managing priorities independently.
Results-oriented, with strong influencing and communication skills.
Fluent in English.




How To Apply




Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
Please upload your CV in English.




About Eni




Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.




Working at Eni




At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.




Energy for action takers

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition 🇫🇷
Description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).


You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.


WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:


You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.


Within 3 months:


You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.


Within 6 months:


You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.


And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:


Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
Increased accountability in project leadership
Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.


Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:


Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
Are Fluent in French & English


What does the recruitment process look like?


A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)


What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :


To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity


We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.

Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to dpo@pennylane.com. Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an dpo@pennylane.com schreiben. Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a dpo@pennylane.com. Más información

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé F/H
Description:

Passionné(e) par la data, l’intelligence artificielle et la transformation des métiers par la donnée ? CRIT, acteur majeur du recrutement et du travail temporaire en France, recherche son/sa futur(e) Data Analyst Confirmé(e) pour accompagner l’accélération de sa stratégie Data & IA au sein de son pôle innovation.

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur Data : de l’exploration des données jusqu’à la production d’insights exploitables, en passant par la conception de modèles analytiques et l'accompagnement des métiers.

Collecter, consolider et exploiter des données issues de multiples sources internes et externes.
Monitorer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées par les équipes métiers.
Concevoir et maintenir des jeux de données et indicateurs de référence pour les différentes directions.
Travailler au sein de l'écosystème Databricks et contribuer à l'exploitation du Lakehouse de l'entreprise.
Rédiger des requêtes SQL performantes, analyses et traitements de données complexes.


Identifier des tendances, corrélations et opportunités d'amélioration business.


Produire des tableaux de bord, reportings et visualisations interactives à destination des équipes métiers et des instances de pilotage.
Accompagner les métiers dans l'interprétation des données et la prise de décision basée sur les faits.
Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation des analyses et des reportings.
Participer à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques de gouvernance, de documentation et de structuration de la donnée.
Concevoir et expérimenter des assistants et agents IA capables d'automatiser des tâches d'analyse, de recherche d'information ou de pilotage de la performance.
Évaluer la valeur métier des solutions IA, mesurer leur impact et accompagner leur adoption au sein des équipes.
Assurer une veille continue sur les évolutions de la Data, de l'Analytics et de l'Intelligence Artificielle.


Ce Que Nous Recherchons


Expériences significatives en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Data moderne.
Excellente maîtrise de SQL et bonne maîtrise de Python pour l'analyse et la transformation de données.
Expérience confirmée sur Databricks
Bonne connaissance des modèles de données, des problématiques de qualité, de gouvernance et de structuration de la donnée.
Solides compétences analytiques et statistiques permettant de transformer les données en recommandations opérationnelles.
Capacité à comprendre rapidement les enjeux métier et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés.
Appétence forte pour l'intelligence artificielle et les usages liés aux LLM, à l'IA générative et aux systèmes agentiques.
Expérience dans l'utilisation ou l'intégration de solutions IA au travers d'API ou de plateformes spécialisées.
Compréhension des enjeux liés à la qualité et la confidentialité ainsi que des notions sur la sécurité et la gouvernance des données.
Curiosité, esprit d'innovation et volonté de faire progresser les pratiques Data et IA de l'entreprise.
Excellentes capacités de communication, de vulgarisation et d'accompagnement au changement.

Impact et Innovation

Un rôle clé dans la structuration de la stratégie Data & IA du Groupe, avec une forte visibilité auprès des directions métiers et digitales.

Technologies modernes

Évoluez dans un environnement en pleine transformation s'appuyant sur Databricks, les architectures Data modernes et les solutions d'intelligence artificielle de nouvelle génération.

💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.

✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Data Analyst au sein d’un pure player de la tech (idéalement une marketplace)

Excellente maîtrise de SQL et Python
Expérience en genAI et ou self-service Analytics

Solides capacités d’analyse et de synthèse
Autonomie, rigueur et sens des priorités
Curiosité, esprit critique et force de proposition
Goût pour le travail en équipe et le partage de connaissances

Se positionner comme business partner et relai des équipes Data de l’entreprise auprès des stakeholders.


Structurer le pilotage et les indicateurs


Accompagner les équipes dans la définition de KPI pertinents, alignés avec leurs objectifs
Être proactif dans la mise en place, l’exploitation et l’amélioration de dashboards

Contribuer au développement des best practices de l’équipe Data Analytics
Porter et diffuser la culture Data au sein de l’entreprise

Conditions de travail agréables (locaux, télétravail…)
Rémunération attractive (fixe, variable et participation)
Opportunités de développement professionnel rapides et personnalisées
