Title: Data Analyst Senior
HTML:
Notre client est une mutuelle reconnue pour ses valeurs humaines et le confort de travail qu'elle offre à ses salariés. L’intégrer est la garantie de rejoindre une structure à taille humaine avec des valeurs fortes. Elle recherche aujourd'hui un Data Analyst Senior pour rejoindre ses équipes.


Vos missions:

  • Recueillir et formaliser les besoins Data des équipes métiers ;
  • Extraire, analyser et modéliser les données issues de différentes sources (DWH, CRM, Oracle...)
  • Concevoir et diffuser des reportings, KPI et tableaux de bord via des outils BI ;
  • Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données ;
  • Accompagner les métiers dans l'analyse des données et la prise de décision ;
  • Automatiser les traitements et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils et processus.


Profil recherché:


Vous êtes diplômé(e)s d’un Bac+3 à Bac+5, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en analyse de données, acquise dans le secteur de l'assurance santé ou de la complémentaire santé.


Vous maîtrisez l'analyse et le traitement de données ainsi que la création, l'organisation et le pilotage de bases de requêtes. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils Office (Excel, Access, VBA...), les outils d'analyse de données tels que Python, R et SQL, ainsi qu'avec les outils de Data Visualisation.


Vous êtes à l'aise avec la production de reportings, l'analyse d'indicateurs et le contrôle de la qualité des données. La maîtrise d'Active'Infinite constitue un fort atout pour le poste. Une connaissance de DigDash est également appréciée.


Capacités humaines attendues :

  • Forte autonomie ;
  • Rigueur et esprit d'analyse ;
  • Capacité de synthèse et esprit critique ;
  • Esprit d'équipe et excellent relationnel ;
  • Sens de l'écoute, pédagogie et réactivité.


Informations pratiques :


  • Localisation : Nice (06) ou Marseille (13)
  • Remote : 2 jours de télétravail par semaine
  • Package : Titres Restaurant, bonne mutuelle familiale, PEE, CSE + autres avantages ;
  • Rémunération : 40k-56k€ fixe (sur 13 mensualités)
  • Semaine de travail de 4 jours


La confidentialité de votre candidature est garantie.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Arcaplanet consolida la propria strategia di crescita attraverso l’apertura di decine di nuovi punti vendita ogni anno su tutto il territorio nazionale, lo sviluppo del canale online e delle soluzioni digitali in un’ottica di omnicanalità integrata, nonché l’ampliamento dell’offerta di servizi dedicati al mondo Pet.




A supporto di tale strategia e con un forte orientamento customer centric, investe nello sviluppo delle professionalità che operano sia nel Retail che nell’Headquarter con l’obiettivo costante di garantire la massima soddisfazione ed un servizio di eccellenza.




Chi siamo e cosa cerchiamo




Stiamo cercando un/a Data Analyst esperto/a per rafforzare il nostro team Data & Analytics. Cerchiamo una persona che sappia trasformare una domanda di business in una risposta affidabile, e che sappia riconoscere quando il dato va ristrutturato perché quella risposta sia semplice e ripetibile. Il valore sta nel ragionamento prima ancora che nello strumento.




Che cosa farai?




Primi mesi: lavorerai sulle richieste operative dei team (estrazioni, report, quadrature) per imparare dal vivo dati, processi e business.
Poi: ownership di un’area di modelli dati e report, con test, documentazione e KPI coerenti.
A regime: analisi a maggior valore e proposte su come strutturare il dato per rispondere meglio.




Responsabilità del Ruolo?




Trasformare domande di business in analisi chiare e azionabili
Progettare e ottimizzare query e modelli su BigQuery, Databricks e dbt
Sviluppare dashboard e report Power BI con KPI coerenti, verificabili e standardizzati
Integrare dati da CRM, e-commerce, retail e web analytics, collaborando con team cross-funzionali
Applicare controlli, naming convention e processi condivisi di qualità e governance del dato
Supportare tracking e misurazione GA4 (web e app), garantendo integrità e continuità del dato
Documentare requisiti, processi e metodologie
Allinearsi regolarmente con il BI & Analytics Manager su priorità, avanzamento e criticità




Cosa fa di te il candidato ideale?




Laurea in discipline quantitative (Statistica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia) preferibile
4–6 anni di esperienza in ruoli di analytics o BI
SQL avanzato e nozioni solide di data modeling (granularità, chiavi, fact e dimension)
Power BI, Excel avanzato e GA4 (web analytics, struttura dei dati e degli eventi)
dbt e Git sono un plus
Abitudine a mettere in discussione la richiesta: perché serve, quale decisione supporta, quale definizione di KPI è in gioco
Rigore sul numero: lo quadra, ne dichiara le assunzioni e i limiti
Capacità di spiegare un risultato a chi non è tecnico
Umiltà e fame: vede l’operatività come il modo più veloce per capire il contesto
Inglese intermedio




Cosa offriamo?




Possibilità di lavorare in modo trasversale con diverse funzioni aziendali;
Percorso a 12–18 mesi verso ownership di un’area e ruolo di referente analytics;
Smart Working;
PData model costruito internamente su stack moderno, con spazio per influenzarne l’evoluzione;
Sconti fino al 40% sui prodotti nei nostri negozi con la nostra ArcaCard
Retribuzione 42.000-50.000 € lordi, CCNL applicato Distribuzione Moderna Organizzata (DMO);
Formazione e certificazioni (dbt, Databricks, Power BI)




Sede Lavorativa?




Milano




#Siamo attenti al pianeta, alle nostre persone e ai nostri amici animali.




Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo bachelor of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen;
  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • AI-affiniteit is een pré.


Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS?

  • 15 keer Top Employer!
  • Uitstekend salaris;
  • Vrije keuze leaseauto;
  • € 5000,- opleidingsbudget;
  • Aantrekkelijke bonussen;
  • Veel sociale evenementen;
  • Uitdagende projecten;
  • Gevarieerde opdrachten;
  • Gerenommeerde klanten.

Wij vinden het leuk om op ons hoofdkantoor of één van onze lokale vestigingen of online kennis te maken. Solliciteer via onderstaande button of neem voor meer informatie contact op met ons recruitment team via:

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Chez PayLead, nous réinventons l'expérience d'achat et l'expérience bancaire en créant des synergies entre les retailers et les institutions financières. Pionniers européens du Payment Marketing, nous construisons un monde où chaque transaction devient une opportunité d'engagement etde création de valeur.

Notre plateforme, propulsée par l'analyse avancée des données transactionnelles, transforme la relation entre banques, marchands et consommateurs. Elle permet aux institutions financières et aux marchands de valoriser au maximum les décisions d'achat quotidiennes des consommateurs. Nos solutions phares :

- Automatic Cashback : notre produit historique, qui récompense automatiquement les consommateurs.

- Seamless Loyalty Card : l'intégration des programmes de fidélité directement dans l'expérience bancaire et les cartes de paiement.

- Easy Voucher : encore plus d'économies pour les clients des banques, grâce à des bons d'achat intégrés aux applications mobiles.

- Transaction Enricher : l'amélioration de la qualité et de la pertinence des données transactionnelles.

PayLead est un acteur de premier plan de la révolution des financial media networks dans les secteurs bancaire et du retail. Nous développons un réseau média financier innovant qui permet aux banques de valoriser leurs canaux digitaux et la richesse de leurs données, en partenariat avec les marques. Cette approche crée une dynamique gagnant-gagnant-gagnant entre les banques, les retailers et les clients consentants : chacune des trois parties en tire de la valeur.

Les banques peuvent proposer à leurs clients des expériences personnalisées, des offres sur mesure et des économies au quotidien, tout en donnant aux marques et aux marchands accès à des audiences qualifiées, fondées sur des comportements d'achat réels.

PayLead aujourd'hui

- Plus de 7 millions d'utilisateurs

- Plus de 25 partenaires bancaires et fintech

- Plus de 150 marchands de premier plan en France, en Espagne et en Belgique

- Des bureaux à Paris

- Plus de 50 PayLeaders passionnés

Tu intègres l’équipe Business Intelligence et seras le bras droit de la Head of BI. Concrètement, la BI est le point d'entrée unique de la donnée dans l'entreprise. Tu travailleras quotidiennement avec l'équipe Data ainsi que les équipes métiers. Mais, ton rôle central dans l'entreprise t'emmènera à échanger avec tous les services de Paylead, des équipes Tech aux équipes financières.

Notre mission tient en trois engagements :

Automatiser l'accès à la donnée et son traitement : collecter, traiter, interpréter et rendre la donnée accessible, pour nos clients internes comme externes.

Répondre aux questions business par l'étude : cadrer un besoin, poser une méthode fiable, croiser les sources et interpréter les résultats pour en tirer une recommandation.

Rendre les équipes autonomes sur la data : rendre les équipes Business autonomes et data-driven, et alerter sur les dysfonctionnements produit.



Ton rôle

Tu prends en charge un périmètre d'analyse et de reporting de bout en bout : de la requête SQL jusqu'à la restitution à une équipe business ou à un client. Une partie de la valeur du poste tient moins à la technique pure qu'à ta capacité à comprendre un besoin métier, à challenger les chiffres et à en tirer une recommandation claire.

1. Faire tourner et enrichir nos rapports automatiques

Nous gérons cinq produits récurrents: des indicateurs de marché aux rapports destinés à nos clients externes, en passant par des projections d'opportunités. Tu fiabilises ces livrables, tu les fais évoluer avec les besoins des équipes, et tu automatises ce qui doit l'être pour que le temps gagné profite à des analyses plus avancées.

2. Répondre aux demandes d'analyse des équipes

Traduire une question business floue en une analyse cadrée, puis en un chiffre défendable.

Construire et maintenir les dashboards de notre outil BI (Metabase), utilisés au quotidien par les équipes.

Produire les études qui appuient un rendez-vous commercial, un renouvellement client ou un article de blog.



3. Surveiller les volumes et diagnostiquer les anomalies

Monitorer les volumes de transactions par marchand, par partenaire bancaire et par marché et renforcer notre alerting pour détecter des anomalies.

Remonter les dysfonctionnements aux équipes Produit et Tech, avec les éléments qui permettent de trancher.



4. Rendre les équipes autonomes

Accompagner les équipes Business dans leur usage de Metabase : où trouver la donnée, comment la lire, quels pièges éviter.

Devenir un interlocuteur de confiance : celui à qui on demande « est-ce que ce chiffre est bon ? » avant de l'envoyer à un client.

Environ 2 ans d'expérience sur un poste d'analyse de données.

L'IA t'intéresse et tu as envie de t'en servir au quotidien pour aller plus vite et avoir plus d'impact.

Tu maîtrises SQL (jointures, fenêtres, agrégations..etc) et tu es à l'aise en Python (Pandas, Numpy, Polars..etc).

Tu es familier d'un outil de BI.

Curiosité et rigueur : tu ne livres pas un chiffre que tu n'as pas compris.

Tu sais « faire parler » la data et la rendre compréhensible par un public business.

Tu as le sens de la pédagogie : une bonne partie du job consiste à expliquer.

Anglais professionnel (nos marchés et nos partenaires ne sont pas qu'en France).



Bonus

Une première expérience dans le retail, la banque, les paiements ou le e-commerce.

Pratique de Git et du déploiement.

Des notions de data modeling ou de dbt.



Échange avec un membre de l'équipe BI.

Une étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d'un entretien technique. Nous évaluons à la fois ton rendu et ta façon de raisonner en direct.

Dernier entretien avec le COO, en charge du pôle "delivery" auquel ton poste sera attaché.

Chez PayLead, nous réinventons l'expérience d'achat et l'expérience bancaire en créant des synergies entre les retailers et les institutions financières. Pionniers européens du Payment Marketing, nous construisons un monde où chaque transaction devient une opportunité d'engagement etde création de valeur.

Notre plateforme, propulsée par l'analyse avancée des données transactionnelles, transforme la relation entre banques, marchands et consommateurs. Elle permet aux institutions financières et aux marchands de valoriser au maximum les décisions d'achat quotidiennes des consommateurs. Nos solutions phares :

- Automatic Cashback : notre produit historique, qui récompense automatiquement les consommateurs.

- Seamless Loyalty Card : l'intégration des programmes de fidélité directement dans l'expérience bancaire et les cartes de paiement.

- Easy Voucher : encore plus d'économies pour les clients des banques, grâce à des bons d'achat intégrés aux applications mobiles.

- Transaction Enricher : l'amélioration de la qualité et de la pertinence des données transactionnelles.

PayLead est un acteur de premier plan de la révolution des financial media networks dans les secteurs bancaire et du retail. Nous développons un réseau média financier innovant qui permet aux banques de valoriser leurs canaux digitaux et la richesse de leurs données, en partenariat avec les marques. Cette approche crée une dynamique gagnant-gagnant-gagnant entre les banques, les retailers et les clients consentants : chacune des trois parties en tire de la valeur.

Les banques peuvent proposer à leurs clients des expériences personnalisées, des offres sur mesure et des économies au quotidien, tout en donnant aux marques et aux marchands accès à des audiences qualifiées, fondées sur des comportements d'achat réels.

PayLead aujourd'hui

- Plus de 7 millions d'utilisateurs

- Plus de 25 partenaires bancaires et fintech

- Plus de 150 marchands de premier plan en France, en Espagne et en Belgique

- Des bureaux à Paris

- Plus de 50 PayLeaders passionnés

Tu intègres l’équipe Business Intelligence et seras le bras droit de la Head of BI. Concrètement, la BI est le point d'entrée unique de la donnée dans l'entreprise. Tu travailleras quotidiennement avec l'équipe Data ainsi que les équipes métiers. Mais, ton rôle central dans l'entreprise t'emmènera à échanger avec tous les services de Paylead, des équipes Tech aux équipes financières.

Notre mission tient en trois engagements :

  • Automatiser l'accès à la donnée et son traitement : collecter, traiter, interpréter et rendre la donnée accessible, pour nos clients internes comme externes.

  • Répondre aux questions business par l'étude : cadrer un besoin, poser une méthode fiable, croiser les sources et interpréter les résultats pour en tirer une recommandation.

  • Rendre les équipes autonomes sur la data : rendre les équipes Business autonomes et data-driven, et alerter sur les dysfonctionnements produit.

Ton rôle

Tu prends en charge un périmètre d'analyse et de reporting de bout en bout : de la requête SQL jusqu'à la restitution à une équipe business ou à un client. Une partie de la valeur du poste tient moins à la technique pure qu'à ta capacité à comprendre un besoin métier, à challenger les chiffres et à en tirer une recommandation claire.

1. Faire tourner et enrichir nos rapports automatiques

Nous gérons cinq produits récurrents: des indicateurs de marché aux rapports destinés à nos clients externes, en passant par des projections d'opportunités. Tu fiabilises ces livrables, tu les fais évoluer avec les besoins des équipes, et tu automatises ce qui doit l'être pour que le temps gagné profite à des analyses plus avancées.

2. Répondre aux demandes d'analyse des équipes

  • Traduire une question business floue en une analyse cadrée, puis en un chiffre défendable.

  • Construire et maintenir les dashboards de notre outil BI (Metabase), utilisés au quotidien par les équipes.

  • Produire les études qui appuient un rendez-vous commercial, un renouvellement client ou un article de blog.

3. Surveiller les volumes et diagnostiquer les anomalies

  • Monitorer les volumes de transactions par marchand, par partenaire bancaire et par marché et renforcer notre alerting pour détecter des anomalies.

  • Remonter les dysfonctionnements aux équipes Produit et Tech, avec les éléments qui permettent de trancher.

4. Rendre les équipes autonomes

  • Accompagner les équipes Business dans leur usage de Metabase : où trouver la donnée, comment la lire, quels pièges éviter.

  • Devenir un interlocuteur de confiance : celui à qui on demande « est-ce que ce chiffre est bon ? » avant de l'envoyer à un client.

  • Environ 2 ans d'expérience sur un poste d'analyse de données.

  • L'IA t'intéresse et tu as envie de t'en servir au quotidien pour aller plus vite et avoir plus d'impact.

  • Tu maîtrises SQL (jointures, fenêtres, agrégations..etc) et tu es à l'aise en Python (Pandas, Numpy, Polars..etc).

  • Tu es familier d'un outil de BI.

  • Curiosité et rigueur : tu ne livres pas un chiffre que tu n'as pas compris.

  • Tu sais « faire parler » la data et la rendre compréhensible par un public business.

  • Tu as le sens de la pédagogie : une bonne partie du job consiste à expliquer.

  • Anglais professionnel (nos marchés et nos partenaires ne sont pas qu'en France).

Bonus

  • Une première expérience dans le retail, la banque, les paiements ou le e-commerce.

  • Pratique de Git et du déploiement.

  • Des notions de data modeling ou de dbt.

  • Échange avec un membre de l'équipe BI.

  • Une étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d'un entretien technique. Nous évaluons à la fois ton rendu et ta façon de raisonner en direct.

  • Dernier entretien avec le COO, en charge du pôle "delivery" auquel ton poste sera attaché.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations


The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:


State of California: $116,000 - $237,000
State of Colorado: $107,000 - $191,000
State of Connecticut: $95,000 - $241,000
State of Illinois: $105,000 - $204,000
State of Maine: $79,000 - $182,000

Jersey City, NJ: $126,000 - $229,000

Washington, D.C.: $150,000 - $220,000


The above salaries do not include a discretionary bonus, however bonus opportunities are non-guaranteed, and are dependent upon individual and firm performance. Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Title: Senior Healthcare Data Analyst, Analytics Hub
Description:
Overview

With over 50 years of proven success, ECG, ranked as a Best Midsized Firm to Work For 2026 by Consulting Magazine, is the most experienced healthcare consulting firm in the US. Working exclusively in this space, our people consistently demonstrate their ability to solve challenges for providers and achieve better patient outcomes. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide.

About ECG

ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans.

Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Job Details

Join Our Analytics Hub

Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform.

Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients:


Position themselves for value-based care delivery.
Align hospitals and physician organizations.
Strengthen financial performance.
Enhance clinical programs.
Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers.


Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Data Analyst

Title: Analyst, Commercial Analytics
Description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK, data is how we make better decisions for travelers and partners alike — and the Commercial Analytics team is at the center of that work. As an Analyst on this globally distributed team, you'll help turn commercial data into clear, actionable insights that directly support revenue decisions across flights, hotels, cars, and advertising, working closely with colleagues across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will


Analyze commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across travel verticals including flights, hotels, cars, and advertising
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization and reporting tools to give commercial teams timely visibility into business performance
Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from commercial teams
Monitor data accuracy, troubleshoot discrepancies, and maintain reporting reliability across existing data sources
Define and document key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with commercial teams, and build models to support forecasting and goal-setting
Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to ensure data quality and translate commercial reporting needs into technical requirements
Contribute to global analytics projects such as inventory forecasting, partner-facing reporting tools, and the development of AI-assisted analytics solutions
Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior commercial leaders.


Please Apply If You Have


At least 2 years of experience working with data in an analytical, business intelligence, operations, or similar role — we value demonstrated ability and transferable skills; equivalent experience, training, or self-directed learning is considered
At least 2 years of hands-on SQL experience, writing queries to explore and manipulate large datasets
Hands-on experience with at least one data visualization or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Superset, Power BI, or a comparable platform)
The ability to communicate data findings clearly to people with varying levels of technical background, including in written summaries and presentations
Curiosity, attention to detail, and an enjoyment of working through ambiguous problems using data
Comfort working in a global, cross-functional environment with colleagues across multiple time zones


To Stand Out, You Also Have


Experience with Python or R for data manipulation, automation, or modeling
Familiarity with the travel, e-commerce, or digital advertising industry
Experience working with AI or agentic analytics tools
Exposure to large-scale data warehouse environments (e.g., Trino, Vertica, or similar).


Benefits And Perks


Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
No meeting Fridays
Paid parental leave
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
Competitive retirement and health plans
Free lunch 2 days per week
Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday socials, and more

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $90,000-$105,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need an accommodation for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

Description:
Summary

As a Program Analyst (Data Analytics), you will supports programs and operations by providing data analytics reporting, business intelligence, and decision-support capabilities.

Location of position: Washington, DC; Kansas City, MO; Fort Worth, TX; Lakewood, CO; Tacoma, WA; ; Atlanta, GA; New York, NY; Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA; Philadelphia, PA; Chicago, IL;

We are currently filling one vacancy, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Learn more about this agency

Duties






Performs broad technical data analysis functions and supports the program objectives in the formulation and implementation of data that streamlines operations, improves efficiency, enhances customer service, and supports mission outcomes.
Designs and conducts complex data efforts, comprehensive data studies, and analytical projects supporting organizational priorities, business transformation initiatives, and operational improvements.
Primarily analyzes complex datasets and develops business-oriented reports, dashboards, and visualizations in support of operations, vehicle lifecycle management, customer engagement, supplier management, financial performance, and strategic initiatives as needed.
Prepares and conducts briefings for higher level management to explain analysis and business intelligence project documentation. Provides recommendations and action plans and proposes direction for implementation of recommendations.
Provides advanced data analysis using a solid knowledge base of various computer program languages and understanding of processing information.



Requirements





Conditions of employment


US Citizenship or National (Residents of American Samoa and Swains Island)
Meet all eligibility criteria within 30 days of the closing date
Meet time-in-grade within 30 days of the closing date, if applicable
Register with Selective Service if you are a male born after 12/31/1959



If selected, you must meet the following conditions:


Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service.
Serve a one year probationary period, if required.
Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 2 investigation level).
Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security’s e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment.



Qualifications

To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below. Your resume must not exceed two pages. To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information:


Name, address, telephone number, email address;
Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade);
Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.
Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.



Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume.

The GS-13salary range starts at $108,173per year. If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected.

To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or higher in the Federal service.

Specialized experience is defined as experience that must include all three of the following:


Utilizing data analytics tools, business intelligence platforms, or programming languages to extract, manipulate, validate, and analyze complex datasets in support of program operations or performance reporting;
Developing and presenting recurring or ad hoc reports, dashboards, data visualizations, or briefing materials that communicate analytical findings and operational trends to management or organizational stakeholders; and
Collaborating with internal or external stakeholders to define analytical requirements, identify and resolve data integrity concerns, and deliver data-driven recommendations that support organizational decision-making or program improvement.



Additional information

Candidates will not be hired based on their race, sex, color, religion, or national origin.

Applicants are encouraged to make their resume searchable in their USAJOBS.gov profile. This will allow Federal hiring specialists and hiring managers across agencies to find their resume as part of agency recruitment campaigns or staffing searches.

If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, contact the agency or visit GSA's webpage.

Relocation-related expenses are not approved and will be your responsibility.

On a case-by-case basis, the following incentives may be approved:


Recruitment incentive if you are new to the federal government
Relocation incentive if you are a current federal employee
Credit toward vacation leave if you are new to the federal government



Additional vacancies may be filled through this announcement in this or other GSA organizations within the same commuting area as needed; through other means; or not at all.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits





A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

You will have access to many benefits including:


Health insurance (choose from a wide range of plans)
Life insurance coverage with several options
Sick leave and vacation time, including 11 paid holidays per year
Thrift Savings Plan (similar to a 401(k) plan)
Transit and child care subsidies
Flexible spending accounts
Long-term care insurance
Training and development



Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

Title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing and Customer Experience
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain-specific marketing and customer experience team's data offerings - including a customer acquisition and retention forecast. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:  

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!  

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location. 

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

Title: Senior Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
It’s an exciting time to join the WellSense Health Plan, a growing regional health insurance company with a 25-year history of providing health insurance that works for our members, no matter their circumstances.

Job Summary

The Senior Pharmacy Data Analyst is a highly experienced and results-driven professional who plays a critical role in advancing the strategic objectives of the Pharmacy Department. Reporting to the Manager of Pharmacy Contracting and Reporting, this role operates with a high degree of autonomy and precision, leveraging deep expertise in pharmacy data analytics to deliver timely, actionable insights that drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and member health outcomes.

This individual is a master of data strategy—skilled in SAS, SQL, and advanced Microsoft tools—with a proven ability to architect complex data models, streamline reporting processes, and lead cross-functional initiatives. The Senior Analyst is responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise-level dashboards, overseeing regulatory submissions, and serving as the Pharmacy Data Steward, ensuring data integrity across systems and stakeholders.

With a minimum of 10 years of industry experience, the ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional analytical acumen, strategic foresight, and a commitment to producing high-quality deliverables efficiently and independently. This role demands a proactive leader who can translate complex data into compelling narratives, influence decision-making, and support cost-effective, data-driven pharmacy benefit management.

Our Investment In You


Full-time remote work
Competitive salaries
Excellent benefits


Key Functions/Responsibilities


Develop and maintain a centralized dashboard for tracking pharmacy financial, operational, and clinical performance measures.
Lead the process of regulatory reporting from development, validation, and submission collaborating with vendor partners to ensure data accuracy.
Conduct data queries to monitor performance metrics, including Medicare STAR measures and quality improvement initiatives.
Oversee PBM submission of all Part D claims to CMS as PDEs, identifying discrepancies and resolving errors to ensure 100% alignment.
Assume the leadership role of Pharmacy Data Steward, advising cross-functional departments on data exchange specifications and serving as the subject matter expert for pharmacy data integrity.
Support program processes by conducting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) testing.
Collaborate with Pharmacy Department team members to identify, prioritize, and analyze customer needs and requests to include the development and execution of sophisticated data-driven strategies that are closely aligned with the company's overarching mission and strategic objectives
Communicate effectively with internal cross-functional areas regarding pharmacy programs, formulary management, and pharmacy processes.
Document workflows, perform analysis, and contribute to the design of systems to meet Pharmacy data needs.
Deliver compelling presentations of findings and insights to internal stakeholders, effectively communicating complex concepts in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner using Utilize leading BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Architect and implement intricate data models, data flows, and data integration processes to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of data collection, storage, and retrieval mechanisms.
Engage collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, data scientists, and developers, to identify optimization opportunities and develop innovative, data-driven solutions.
Utilize leading BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI to create dynamic, visually compelling reports and distribute actionable insights effectively.
Harness advanced tools such as Excel (including VBA), Python, or R to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data with precision and sophistication.
Other duties as assigned


Supervision Received




General direction and supervision by Manager of Pharmacy Contracting and Reporting


Qualifications

Education Required:


Bachelor's degree in mathematics, information management, information systems, statistics, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.


Education Preferred


Master's degree preferred.


Experience Required


Minimum of 5 years of healthcare experience.
Working knowledge of industry coding standards (e.g., generic product indicators, national drug codes, GPI’s, etc.).


Experience Preferred/Desirable


Minimum of 10 years in health insurance or with a PBM
Working knowledge of industry coding standards (e.g., generic product indicators, national drug codes, GPI’s, etc.).
Extensive experience analyzing pharmacy claims data, formulary utilization, and drug cost trends.
Familiarity with Medicare Part D data, STAR measures, and PDE submissions
Required Licensure, Certification or Conditions of Employment:
Successful completion of pre-employment background check


Competencies, Skills, And Attributes


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, adept at presenting complex data insights to senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
Advanced technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, Power Query), with strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Skilled in additional BI and reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent).
Deep understanding of IT and business processes, with proven ability to translate clinical and operational requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Demonstrated ability to influence, consult, and build consensus across multiple stakeholders, driving collaboration between business, IT, and vendor teams.
Strong clinical and operational problem-solving skills with experience in synthesizing large, complex datasets into actionable insights and executive-ready reports.
Proficient in designing, developing, and automating queries, dashboards, and ad hoc reports that support strategic decision-making.
Committed to data integrity, accuracy, and quality, with meticulous attention to detail and validation processes.
Quick to adopt new systems, tools, and analytic approaches, consistently staying ahead of industry trends and best practices.
Ability to organize, synthesize, and analyze large volumes of information.
Skilled at prioritizing multiple initiatives, managing timelines, and delivering high-quality outputs in fast-paced environments.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to producing analytic products of the highest accuracy.
Strong interpersonal skills with a track record of thriving in collaborative, team-based environments.


Working Conditions And Physical Effort


Ability to work OT during peak periods. (Non-Exempt Positions)
Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of the position.
Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment.
No or very limited physical effort required. No or very limited exposure to physical risk.


Compensation Range

$77,000 - $111,500

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensure as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, WellSense offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family wellbeing.

Note: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

About WellSense

WellSense Health Plan is a nonprofit health insurance company serving more than 740,000 members across Massachusetts and New Hampshire through Medicare, Individual and Family, and Medicaid plans. Founded in 1997, WellSense provides high-quality health plans and services that work for our members, no matter their circumstances. WellSense is committed to the diversity and inclusion of staff and their members.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. WellSense participates in the E-Verify program to electronically verify the employment eligibility of newly hired employees

Title: Business Analytics Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

CarGurus is seeking a Business Analytics Analyst to join the Business Analytics & Reporting team. This team is responsible for the analytical rigor behind reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling that enable day-to-day and strategic decisions. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious and an exceptional critical thinker; they can live in the data, understanding the logic and processes that generate it as well as detecting signals, diagnosing problems, proposing solutions, and predicting future behavior. They can then use their mastery to synthesize and convey important information to other parties and offer thoughtful ways in which things can be improved.

The Business Analytics Team has a wide remit at CarGurus. You’ll work with many departments, gaining a broad exposure to the operation of the business, and be asked to connect the dots between them. Your rich understanding, technical skills, and thought partnership will make you a highly sought-after contributor for a wide variety of stakeholders, including senior leaders.

What You'll Do


With the assistance of AI tools, conduct exploratory data analysis across disparate data sources to understand the performance of the business and identify potential opportunities and/or risks.
Be an active contributor in discussions with decision-makers, using cognitive empathy to understand their vantage point and incentives before using this understanding to structure and frame downstream work and resulting findings.
Use data to identify, validate, and uncover causal relationships of important business mechanisms.
Implement new metrics to evaluate business performance and/or experiments and build reports and dashboards to monitor and understand them.
Be a voice and advocate to use data to improve the quality of our decision-making.


What You'll Bring


BS or BA in computer science, mathematics, statistics, analytics, or economics, with equivalent analytical work experience or a MS degree in a relevant field of study.
2+ years of professional experience focused on analysis and reporting, including the use of data visualization tools, to influence understanding and decision-making.
Ability to understand systems and business goals to help modernize and innovate on present data structures and models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using hypothesis-driven analysis to solve questions and give guidance.
Fluent in SQL and an analytical tool; experience with Git, Python, and LLMs is a plus.
Some experience with data modeling and ETL concepts.
Proficient at working with data ambiguity to derive meaningful insights.
Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills.
Able to manage multiple projects effectively, set expectations with partners, and complete projects on time.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Dealer
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Dealer team which tackles a complex data environment, building out core assets, running experiments, and many more unstructured analytics tasks to support the growth of the dealer product suite.

Our Product Data Analytics org as a whole supports our Product and Engineering teams, providing the final word on all analytics for CarGurus’ user and dealer experiences. We are looking for thoughtful, curious, internally driven candidates who can dive into complex data and draw novel, insightful conclusions.

What You’ll Do


Conduct exploratory empirical analyses using SQL and Python that bridge disparate data sources (e.g. website usage, subscription records, inventory volumes, etc.). to quantify product performance, user behavior, and/or market trends. Distill unstructured “big data” around product performance, user behavior and/or market insights into actionable outcomes.
Creatively compress sweeping, high-level exploratory requests into specific calculations that address your stakeholders’ underlying needs. Relentlessly dig into the data, taking initiative to consult with other individuals and teams as you judge necessary. Go beyond the letter of the initial assignment, to hammer out any anomalies or self-direct your inquiry into other relevant issues.
Advocate and participate in brainstorming/planning sessions for specific, data-driven product innovations that help further high-level company strategy, primarily in partnership with the Product/Engineering teams.
Avoid passivity in the face of flawed proposals; tactfully and persuasively push back against potential missteps.
Craft, audit and improve metrics that define business success, condensing abstract or loosely-defined concepts down to concrete calculations.
Experiment with new kinds of visualizations, build intuitive dashboards and other visual monitoring tools to guide daily decision-making by senior stakeholders and the company at large. Re-work underlying code to appropriately structure visualization inputs.
Communicate and present complex quantitative findings in easily digestible terms to company leadership, homing in on key takeaways. Concretely and informatively respond to any probing, on-the-spot follow-up questions from senior decision-makers.
Conceive of new data assets and build automated transformations (via DBT, LookML, etc.) to bring them to fruition.
Partner with Data Engineering teams to advance core data modeling/architecture (e.g. user clickstream logging), by optimizing, integrating, and distilling large raw datasets and metadata.
Draw upon prior experience with expansive, unrefined datasets to fix modeling bottlenecks in quick, scalable, outside-of-the-box ways.
Use Claude Code and agentic workflows to automate, accelerate, and escalate the sophistication of your analyses.
Be comfortable escalating and automating your analyses using R/Python scripting.


What You’ll Bring


4+ years of experience in analytics, ideally involving complex modeling, quantitative analysis and applied statistics 2+ years of experience communicating the high-impact results of analyses to leadership teams to influence strategy
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI to optimize workflows and agentic coding platforms like Claude Code (preferred) or Cursor
Expert fluency in SQL. A strong background with either R or Python is highly desirable.
Second-nature understanding of core statistical concepts (regression, significance testing, omitted variable bias, independence/dependence, etc.)
Willingness to step outside your role and independently come up with novel ideas for the business.
Willingness to challenge others’ ideas and advocate for your own.
Strong project planning skills, with experience building roadmaps, estimating required resources, and flagging inter-dependencies with other teams/projects.
Preferred tools/programs: Snowflake, Snowplow, dbt, Claude Code or Cursor, Looker/Omni, Jira, Salesforce, Google/MS suite

Title: Sr Analyst BI & Insights
Description:
Senior Analyst, BI & Insights

Reporting, Analytics & Development | Work location: Framingham

Staples is business to business. You’re what binds us together.

Our Customer Success organization is looking for a strategic analytics partner who can move beyond traditional reporting to identify opportunities, surface operational risks, clarify performance trends, and help leaders turn data into action. In this role, you will shape what should be measured, explain why it matters, and provide insights that strengthen organizational effectiveness.

Our world class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best-in-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

The Reporting, Analytics & Development (RAD) team partners with Customer Success leaders to establish meaningful performance measures and deliver reporting solutions that support operational planning and informed decision-making. The team combines business consulting, analytics, KPI strategy, data governance, and visualization expertise to create clear and actionable performance narratives.

The Senior Analyst, BI & Insights serves as a strategic analytics partner to Customer Success leadership. Working with limited direction, this role proactively identifies business opportunities, operational risks, performance trends, and performance gaps; develops KPI recommendations; and helps leaders answer questions they may not yet know to ask. The Senior Analyst translates complex business objectives into measurable outcomes, executive-ready insights, and clear recommendations that drive action. This individual contributor role does not have direct people management responsibilities.

What you’ll be doing:


Identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps across Customer Success functions.
Conduct deep-dive analyses, root cause analyses, and trend investigations to uncover actionable business insights.
Define KPI frameworks, metric definitions, business rules, calculations, governance standards, and ownership.
Facilitate discovery sessions and translate business questions into measurable outcomes.
Develop executive insight summaries, performance narratives, presentations, and recommendations for leadership.
Define dashboard objectives, audiences, measures, wireframes, mockups, and visualization requirements.
Partner with RAD visualization colleagues to design, build, enhance, and maintain Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations.
Identify leading indicators, thresholds, exception-reporting requirements, and proactive alerting strategies.
Validate that reporting solutions clearly communicate trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
Recommend new performance measures, dashboard enhancements, and monitoring approaches when existing metrics are inadequate.
Provide analytical guidance, consulting, and subject-matter expertise to leaders, stakeholders, and RAD partners.
What you bring to the table:
Strong analytical, problem-solving, consulting, and business process analysis skills.
The ability to translate complex data into clear business narratives and actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
The ability to work directly with senior leaders and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.
Knowledge of KPI strategy, performance measurement, data visualization, and data governance.
Independent judgment in determining analytical approaches, priorities, and recommendations.
The ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams, including when stakeholders have competing objectives.


What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent work experience.
3+ years of experience supporting analytics, strategy, business intelligence, operations, or consulting functions; defining KPIs; working with senior leaders; and translating business objectives into analytical solutions.
Experience with AI-enabled analytical solutions.
Advanced knowledge of Power BI and dashboard design principles.
Experience with SQL and analytical data exploration.
Experience developing KPI frameworks and performance measurement strategies.
Knowledge of data visualization best practices, Microsoft Excel, data governance concepts, and business process analysis.


What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with Snowflake.
Experience with Salesforce Analytics.
Experience with Power Automate.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques.
Understanding of predictive analytics concepts.


We Offer:


Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)
Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!


The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.

Qualifications and Skills:

Familiarity with energy efficiency improvements, water conservation measures, and greenhouse gas emissions inventories


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including experience drafting technical reports and presenting findings


Experience working with and managing large, complex datasets


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team


Strong interpersonal skills with a customer service focus


Ability to take initiative, stay organized, and manage multiple tasks
