Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.

You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.

What You’ll Do


Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).
Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.
Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.
4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.
Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.
Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.
Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.
Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.
Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in life science industry


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal and visual presentation of information.

High attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
Resilient, adaptable and driven to achieve desired outcomes.


Desirable


Knowledge of project controls, programme management and PMO disciplines.
Experience working with complex, multi-source datasets.


Experience

Essential


Proven experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards and data models.
Experience manipulating and analysing complex datasets from multiple sources.
Experience managing reporting requests, issues and enhancement logs.

Experience delivering reporting solutions in a programme, portfolio or operational environment.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for independently delivering on multiple common tasks during a Business Intelligence project on time and of high quality. Depending on the skills and career goals of the analyst, these tasks would include either business consulting and visualization, or technical data design and analysis, or both.

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is a quantitative analytics professional who specializes in delivering actionable insights and analytics to business users, leveraging an enterprise analytics framework, infrastructure, and operating model

Relevant business areas that could be supported by the analyst span across clinical and operational areas, including but not limited to clinical operations, nursing, quality and patient safety, finance, HR, supply chain, strategy, pharmacy, clinical disciplines, and informatics solutions areas.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities


Responsible for working on multiple (2-3) projects simultaneously supporting multiple business stakeholders.
Collaborate with manager to identify high level business need, develop project charter, and consult with the business to define scope.
Lead business requirement gathering
Identify data source(s) and develop technical data design requirements.
Develop viz wireframes and leverage BI tools to craft visualizations and dashboards.
Write SQL queries to develop data sources.
Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders for QA and UAT. Conduct stakeholder training. Share knowledge within ED&A and train analysts on common tasks.
Contribute to development of analytic assets that can be used institute wide. Address stakeholder feedback, concerns and aim to deliver a high-level of customer service.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required


Proficient with SQL.
Proficient with BI tools e.g., Tableau.
Proficient navigating Epic Hyperspace to Clarity Data Model to data warehouse.
Able to set appropriate expectations, discuss and present results to customer in formal settings, share ideas accurately and communicate them effectively, both in writing and verbally with supervisory oversight.
Ability to contribute to the development and growth of others.
Strong interpersonal skills with ability to effectively interact with all levels of staff.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and time management skills.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Curious and motivated learner.


Minimum Education

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field required.

Minimum Experience

3 years of relevant experience, with at least 1 year in healthcare. Tableau and Clarity Data model experience preferred.

License/Certification/Registration

Tableau certification required within 6 months of hire.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Leader Bank is looking for exceptionally dedicated team members to join one of the region’s fastest growing community banks and mortgage lenders. At the time of its founding in 2002, Leader Bank had one branch office, $6.5 million in assets and 7 team members. Since then, the Bank has become one of the most successful banks in Massachusetts with more than $5 billion in assets, 450+ team members, 7 branch offices, and annual mortgage originations of over $2 billion.

Exemplary products and an innovative spirit have driven Leader Bank’s rapid growth over the years, and our team members embrace these values. Our mission is to obsess over our clients, make them feel valued, and maintain long-term relationships with them by constantly enhancing our products and processes to always improve our client experience. For our team members, Leader Bank prioritizes competitive compensation and benefits, a healthy work-life balance, and an environment that fosters diversity and inclusion.

Summary

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.
Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.
Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.
Reporting & Visualization
Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.
Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.
Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.
Data Engineering & Automation
Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.
Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
Governance & Quality
Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.
Collaboration
Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.
Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.
Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.
3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.
Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.
Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.
Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.
Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
Knowledge of API development and integrations.
Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.
Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.

Title: SIU Fraud Analyst
Description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Health Plan Holding Company, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Mass General Brigham Health Plan is an exciting place to be within the healthcare industry. As a member of Mass General Brigham, we are at the forefront of transformation with one of the world’s leading integrated healthcare systems. Together, we are providing our members with innovative solutions centered on their health needs to expand access to seamless and affordable care and coverage.

Our work centers on creating an exceptional member experience – a commitment that starts with our employees. Working with some of the most accomplished professionals in healthcare today, our employees have opportunities to learn and contribute expertise within a welcoming and supportive environment that embraces their unique and varied backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

We are pleased to offer competitive salaries and a benefits package with flexible work options, career growth opportunities, and much more.

The Fraud Analyst is building data analytics for MGB Health Plan's Special Investigations Unit; this role uses data analytics for the SIU to find fraud leads. This includes creating SQL queries for known fraud schemes to run against claims data, ad hoc regulatory reporting, and creating reports to support Fraud Investigators.

The ideal candidate is proficient in SQL and has a background in healthcare fraud investigations.

The role will be responsible for creating, refining, and performing various analytic reports aimed at identifying potential fraudulent, wasteful, or abusive claim submissions. In addition to performing analytics, the position will be required to conduct preliminary research of identified providers or members to include public records, contracts, and social media review, among others. The analyst will be accountable for documenting analytic and research activities within concise reports or memoranda.

Essential Functions


Develop and run reports, analyze data to identify suspicious billing patterns, assess the merits of allegations, and present those findings to leadership.
Analyze claims data to find suspicious billing patterns and outliers, using knowledge of healthcare coding conventions, fraud schemes, and general areas of vulnerabilities.
Conduct preliminary investigations to assess the merits of allegations through fact-gathering and analyses of data sets.
Organize data and document preliminary investigative steps with a high level of detail and accuracy to clearly and concisely support investigative inferences, conclusions, and recommendations.
Report discoveries of fraud or program abuse to external parties, as required by law, rule, or contract.
Receive investigative requests from field staff, internal claims associates, and underwriting.


Qualifications

Education


Bachelor's Degree


Experience


At least 2-3 years of experience investigating claims or compliance required
At least 2-3 years of experience as an analyst in healthcare, data reporting or data analysis required
Healthcare fraud experience highly preferred
Data analysis with SQL proficiency highly preferred


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills.
Comprehensive knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD10-CM diagnosis, and procedure codes.
Strong aptitude for technology-based solutions.
Ability to develop, introduce, defend, and gain support for new ideas and approaches.
Ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovative thinking and the capability to successfully implement strategy.

This is a full-time role with a Monday through Friday schedule, generally 8:30-5:00 PM Eastern Time

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain.

The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our purpose is to create a more connected and Judgement Free™ planet, where fitness and wellbeing are within reach for all. That commitment extends to our team members and how we work together.

Breaking Boundaries Together is how we bring our employee experience to life, creating a place where people can show up as themselves, explore what’s possible, continue to grow and achieve more together than they can alone. Guided by our PLANET Principles, we put people first, lead with authenticity and integrity, embrace change and thrive together.

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!

Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.

Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement



Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.



Cross-Functional Partnership



Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.



Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, marketing science, or a related analytical discipline
Demonstrated experience partnering with Marketing and business leaders to deliver analytics, reporting, and actionable recommendations that influence strategic and operational decisions
Experience analyzing marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign effectiveness, and customer engagement
Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies, including attribution, A/B testing, incrementality, customer segmentation, and marketing ROI
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics that improve visibility into business performance
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations
Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms
Experience working with modern analytics and marketing platforms such as Snowflake, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, CRM platforms, or similar technologies
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and recommend data-driven solutions
Extremely detail-oriented, efficient, and organized with an exceptional ability to establish priorities and objectives
Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally
Dedicated learner with a natural curiosity for consistent growth
Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, “can-do” attitude!



Perks

Planet Fitness cares about you and your well-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance.

The salary for MA-based and NH-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Annual Base Salary Range: $110,000-$135,000

Note to Applicants: We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

Title: Senior Analyst, Procurement Data & Analytics
Description:
Acute Care Technology

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.

At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.

Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!

ZOLL Medical does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need ZOLL immigration sponsorship (e.g. H1B, TN, STEM, OPT, etc.) either now or in the future.

The Opportunity

Procurement has stood up a new Data & Analytics team inside our Center of Excellence, and this is one of its first hires. The team is chartered to build the analytical backbone for the entire Procurement organization — Direct and Indirect Sourcing, Purchasing, Supplier Quality Engineering, and Cost Reduction. As the team's Senior Analyst, you won't inherit legacy reports; you'll build the function's first spend cube, its first live Oracle Fusion Analytics dashboards, and the automated data pipelines behind them.

Your work will be highly visible: the dashboards and insights you build will be the reporting foundation that Procurement and executive leadership rely on to steer cost reduction, supplier performance, and supply continuity decisions across a global medical device business. You'll be a part of a small team, by design, where we push each other to be innovative, forward-thinking and high performing.

What You'll Build In Year One


Spend Cube: Partner with the Data & Analytics Manager to design and deliver Procurement's first spend cube (supplier × commodity × cost center) in Oracle Fusion Analytics
Live Dashboards: Replace manual, ad-hoc reporting processes with live, self-service dashboards for spend, supplier performance, and category views
Product Analytics: Build repeatable product-line dashboards covering forecasting, supplier quality, and supply risk — then automate the data pipelines behind them
Data Quality Foundation: Help establish data ownership, validation, and a "clean in, clean out" standard across Oracle Cloud, Workday Sourcing, and connected systems
Predictive Readiness: Contribute to exception-based reporting and the roadmap toward predictive analytics and AI-readiness


Essential Functions


Develop, maintain, and improve procurement dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks across all ZOLL ACT sites
Analyze procurement spend across suppliers, commodities, and sites to surface savings opportunities and support cost reduction initiatives
Translate complex, multi-system data into clear, actionable insights for Purchasing, Sourcing, SQE, and leadership stakeholders
Design and automate recurring reporting processes, reducing manual effort and improving data reliability
Develop and maintain supplier performance reporting and scorecards
Support cost and price variance analysis and procurement-related financial metrics
Maintain and validate key procurement and planning data within Oracle Cloud; champion data quality at the source
Analyze demand, supply, and inventory trends to identify material risks and operational impacts
Provide analytical support to buyers and purchasing teams, balancing strategic build work with operational needs


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, Operations, or a related field
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, procurement, supply chain, or related analytical functions
Proficiency in SQL and structuring large, multi-source datasets for analysis
Hands-on experience building dashboards in a modern BI platform (Oracle Fusion Analytics, Power BI, or Tableau)
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query and data modeling
Proven ability to convert findings into actionable business insights and communicate them to non-technical stakeholders


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with procurement, sourcing, planning, or inventory data in a manufacturing environment
Experience working within ERP systems, preferably Oracle Cloud
Experience with spend analysis, supplier performance reporting, or KPI development
Exposure to data pipeline automation, exception-based reporting, or predictive analytics


Deep procurement domain expertise is not required — we will teach you procurement. We're prioritizing analytical horsepower, curiosity, and the ability to build.

How We'll Invest In You

This team develops people deliberately. You'll join with a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, a competency framework spanning five priority areas (data modeling, insights generation, visualization, business acumen, and financial acumen), an individual development plan built in your first quarter, and a clear progression path within a growing analytics function. By the end of year one, you'll independently own multiple reporting workstreams.

Location & Work Arrangement

This role is open to remote candidates across the U.S., with periodic onsite collaboration at our Chelmsford, MA site (approximately quarterly, plus onboarding). Candidates local to the Boston area who prefer a hybrid arrangement are equally welcome.

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

$90,000.00 to $110,000.00

Description:
Why We Exist

Senior Business Analyst / Data Analyst

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst / Data Analyst to support large-scale healthcare data modernization initiatives within a state government environment. This role serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical data teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and scalable data solutions.




The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of business analysis, healthcare data, SQL, data warehousing, and cloud-based data platform experience. This individual will work closely with data architects, engineers, developers, project managers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to support the modernization of enterprise healthcare data and reporting platforms.




Location & Schedule

Hybrid: Onsite in Quincy, MA one day per month, with occasional additional onsite meetings




Required Industry Experience

Previous experience within healthcare or state government is required
Experience working with healthcare data, ideally within Medicaid, health insurance, public health, or healthcare services
Understanding of HIPAA, sensitive healthcare information, and data privacy requirements




Key Responsibilities

Gather, analyze, and document detailed business, functional, technical, and data requirements for complex data initiatives.
Serve as the bridge between business users and technical/data teams, translating business needs into technical requirements, data solutions, and reporting capabilities.
Perform complex data analysis, data profiling, validation, and SQL querying to ensure data accuracy and identify business insights.
Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of enterprise data warehouse and cloud-based data solutions.
Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, project managers, analysts, QA teams, vendors, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, use-case development, and data platform implementation sessions.
Create clear business and technical documentation to support development teams and end users.
Present requirements, findings, recommendations, and project updates to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
Support AWS and Snowflake-based data modernization initiatives and help establish documented standards, processes, and best practices.
Assist with BI reporting and data platform training, ensuring end users understand available data and reporting capabilities.
Contribute to project planning, milestones, prioritization, and delivery while working within established PMO processes.

Required Qualifications

Strong experience with requirements gathering and business analysis for enterprise data platforms
Excellent SQL querying skills
Strong data analysis, profiling, validation, and troubleshooting experience
Experience with data warehouses and enterprise data solutions
Experience translating business requirements into technical/data requirements
Experience working with sensitive healthcare information and HIPAA/data privacy controls
Strong documentation, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills
Ability to communicate effectively with both business and highly technical audiences
Experience with at least one BI/reporting platform such as Tableau or Cognos




Preferred Technical Experience

AWS cloud services
Snowflake
Tableau
Enterprise data modernization or migration initiatives
Healthcare or Medicaid data environments

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics
Description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst to provide advanced analytical support for our Contact Center Workforce Management (WFM) function.

This role will leverage workforce data, analytics, and technology to optimize staffing strategies, strengthen workforce planning, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making. The Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst will partner closely with HRBPs, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to translate complex workforce and operational data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and technical capabilities, an understanding of contact center and workforce management operations, and the ability to connect workforce insights with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Analytics & Insights


Collect, analyze, and interpret workforce and contact center operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that support workforce and operational decisions.
Conduct root cause analyses related to service levels, staffing, capacity, productivity, and workforce performance.
Identify emerging workforce trends and proactively recommend actions to improve operational effectiveness.
Partner with stakeholders to develop and enhance predictive models that improve workforce forecasting and planning.


Workforce Planning & Forecasting


Partner with WFM leaders to develop data-driven staffing and capacity models aligned with business objectives and operational requirements.
Provide analytical support for short- and long-term workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
Perform scenario modeling to evaluate the workforce implications of changes in demand, staffing, productivity, and business requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve staffing efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, and cost management.
Support workforce forecasts and provide insights into potential staffing gaps, risks, and opportunities.


Reporting & Visualization


Develop and maintain workforce reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, and other relevant technologies.
Establish and maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable workforce metrics across reporting processes and data sources.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready insights.
Present complex information in a concise and understandable format for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to automate and improve workforce reporting and analytics.


Performance & Optimization


Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to workforce efficiency, service levels, productivity, capacity, and operational effectiveness.
Monitor performance trends and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
Benchmark performance against internal targets and relevant industry standards to inform workforce strategies.
Recommend process improvements that strengthen WFM operations and overall organizational effectiveness.
Measure the impact of workforce initiatives and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.


Technology & Data Enablement


Leverage Workday and workforce management/contact center platforms, including AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or similar technologies, to support workforce analytics, forecasting, scheduling, reporting, and decision-making.
Utilize Workday workforce and organizational data alongside operational data sources to develop integrated workforce insights and reporting.
Utilize advanced analytics tools and enterprise data platforms to improve the accuracy, accessibility, and usability of workforce information.
Support the implementation and integration of new tools, technologies, and processes that strengthen workforce analytics capabilities.
Partner with HR, HRBPs, Technology, Operations, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and system capabilities.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and increase the scalability of workforce analytics.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in workforce analytics, workforce management, contact center operations, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience using workforce data and analytics to support operational and business decision-making.
Experience working within a complex, cross-functional organization preferred.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel, with experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical models.
Experience working with Workday, including workforce, organizational, and employee data for reporting and analytics.
Experience with workforce management or contact center technologies such as AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of forecasting methodologies, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and data mining.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and analyze data from multiple sources and translate complex datasets into meaningful business insights.
Experience with data visualization, reporting automation, and analytical storytelling.


Core Capabilities


Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently identify issues, analyze alternatives, and recommend solutions.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect workforce analytics with broader business and operational priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and fact-based recommendations.
Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.


Physical Requirements And Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this role is $90,000-$130,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in an annual short-term incentive program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Benefits

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

Work Authorization

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

Next Steps


If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team


Don't meet every single requirement? At Galderma, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

If you are considering employment at Galderma, review our job postings at www.galderma.com/us/careers. Please be aware of fraudulent job offers and individuals falsely claiming to represent our Human Resources department. Our company will never request or offer payment, personal financial information, or sensitive data (such as Social Security numbers or bank details) during the early stages of recruitment. All legitimate communications from our HR team will come from official company email domains and follow our established hiring process.

Title: Data Analyst, Routing and Scheduling
Description:
DIVISION: BPS Operations

OFFICE: Transportation Department

TEAM: Data & Strategy

ACADEMIC/NON-ACADEMIC: NON-ACADEMIC

____________________________________________________________________________________

REPORTS TO: Assistant Director of Data Management

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Boston Public Schools Office of Transportation is one of the largest departments in the district overseeing a nearly $200M annual budget (~12% of total spending). The Transportation office provides over 600 buses that transport nearly 20,000 students across the district as well as local parochial, private and charter schools. This is one of the largest and most complex school bus transportation systems in the country. The Data Analyst for Routing and Scheduling works within the BPSDOT Data Team providing technology system management, fleet schedule assembly and management, and reporting and data analysis to support overall effective and efficient routing and fleet scheduling.

Responsibilities:

Technology System Management:


Maintain technology systems related to routing (e.g., Zum, Geotab) and adapt these systems to shifting business needs
Serve as primary liaison with vendors to ensure BPS DOT is:
Using the most appropriate version of software
Utilizing the software to its fullest potential
Up to date on training all necessary staff
Serve as liaison between the BPS routing team, BPS Technology and transportation contractors
Develop and run queries to perform data extractions needed by teams in the department from various data sources including the routing system as well as the district's student information system.
Manage data in all software systems related to routing and ensure data is properly synced with external data sources.
Implement data auditing strategies and processes to ensure data integrity


Fleet schedule assembly and management


Create and maintain fleet schedule that balances performance and efficiency
Assist with optimization and troubleshooting of routes


Reporting and data analysis


Gather and translate user requirements into technical specifications
Develop and generate reports and dashboards for various stakeholders such as BPSDOT staff, the Executive Director of Transportation, COO, Superintendent and Mayors Office
Perform complex analyses on routing data to improve efficiency and bus performance
Collaboration with operational department managers (e.g. Operations, Customer Service, Monitors Unit)
Understand operational complexities as they relate to routing and incorporate into data flows and checks
Support training of other departmental staff on how to use routing and fleet data and technology to improve operational procedures
Participate in strategy setting and development for the Transportation Department


Qualifications - Required:


A Bachelor's Degree or higher in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Engineering, Actuarial, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or similar field
1+ years working in a data management/ technological systems maintenance capacity
Expert analytical skills, demonstrating a mastery of Python or R, SQL, and either Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
Strong understanding of data warehousing principles and methodologies
Ability to create project plans / timelines, collecting input from stakeholders and sharing back outputs
Strong written and oral communication skills, in particular the ability to explain data systems and analyses to non-technical audience
Highly organized and detail oriented


Qualifications - Preferred:

Candidates should have a demonstrated history of infusing the following traits into their work:


Curiosity - We need people to help our organization drive improvement. We feel that this requires a healthy desire to discover how and why things work the way they do. We also want candidates to be able to look for those explanations in data.
Quantitative Orientation – Some people think that everything is measurable, that all information can have a more precise and reliable measurement. This is who we want on our team; someone whose approach to everything is rigorous, inquisitive, and analytical.
Persistence – You will have to deal with messy datasets and new and evolving problems in an operation that is learning how to use data effectively. We need you to be able to work through a problem until it is solved, not until you reach a road block.
Vision – This role is about more than just using quantitative skills to answer other people’s questions. We need someone who can help identify problems and opportunities, and who knows how to ask the right questions to address them.
Technical Skills – If quantitative orientation is about a candidate’s will to use data, this trait is about the skill. We need someone who is trained in computer science, statistics, mathematics, and/or economics. But we also want someone who is constantly acquiring technical skills and understands the value of a multidisciplinary approach to problem solving.
Teamwork – We believe that excellent teams, composed of high-performing team members, can have an enormous impact. New team members are valued for their diverse experiences and commitment to service. They must also continuously seek input from a diverse set of perspectives and think critically about the impact of their work.
Communication – This is one of the most important skills to have when working in a team environment. Being able to clearly convey your thoughts/ideas to any audience is vital to the success of this position. We need someone who can explain highly technical things to anyone.


Terms: Managerial, C53. City of Boston Residency is Required.

Title: Marketing Analyst
Description:
The primary role of this individual will be to build, enhance, and maintain a business intelligence platform to support business intelligence and advanced analytics requirements. The selected candidate will engage with our business and operations teams from initial project definition through to project completion and will engage on multiple projects. Primary responsibilities will include the development of reporting and analytical solutions, a full suite of documentation, as well as some light application updates to enable such solutions.

Deliverables include company reporting and dashboard solutions, documentation, light application enhancements, and custom analysis. The results of your work will allow us to streamline our reporting operations and enable the generation of new insights that will allow us to transform our Analytics & Insights efforts to support business strategy, as well as marketing and operations.

What You'll Do


Analyze complex datasets, extracted using SQL, to deliver actionable insights for the Lottery’s digital initiatives to drive good business decisions
Analyze and benchmark performance across multiple channels and platforms, and provide recommendations for areas of future growth
Analyze CRM bonus campaign performance and provide recommendations for the generation of new campaigns
Perform industry monitoring and reporting to keep the management team well informed of interactive market trends and innovations
Elicit analytical and reporting requirements from the Lottery and work with Product Owners to ensure the requirements are delivered
Attend the Lottery meetings and internal meetings to stay informed of new requests, features, and improvement areas, and provide support when necessary
Attend training and conferences as necessary to build knowledge and refine skills
Coordinate projects or requirement elicitation between the Lottery and vendors, when assigned


What We're Looking For


3+ years of experience working within a Marketing Analytics/Business Analytics environment, with a focus on strategy, operations, and marketing data analysis
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with a focus in Business, Marketing, or Economics preferred
Knowledge of SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) with writing complex SQL Queries
Advanced Excel (Power Pivot, Power View, Power Query, Pivot Tables, Lookups, etc.)
Expertise in gathering and documenting internal and external client requirements
Expertise in analyzing complex data sets and converting them into actionable insights, which drives business decisions
Experience in ensuring data integrity and validating results, with high attention to detail and accuracy
Support, advise, and collaborate to deliver ad-hoc reports and data, as necessary to meet the needs of the department
Experience with the Power BI reporting tools.
Capable of investigating, familiarizing, and mastering new data sets quickly
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong problem-solving skills
Motivated individual with technical-functional expertise who can collaborate with both business and technology teams
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently
Gaming analysis experience preferred but not required

Title: Lead Specialist, Business Analytics
Description:
The Lead Specialist, Business Analytics for Customer Experience (CX) leverages CX best practices and strong data analysis to ensure the business has actionable insights based on structured and unstructured customer feedback. They work closely with the businessto:





Define use cases for new data models or views that empower teams to make decisions



Identify gaps and/or areas for growth in data collection across the end-to-end customer journey



Identify new sources of customer feedback for inclusion in aggregated CX analysis



Leverage AI and automation to increase engagement with closed feedback loop activities





Key Responsibilities





Analyze customer experience data across products, business units, and geographies to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that inform strategic decisions.



Develop actionable insights and reporting outputs that support business-defined use cases and enable data-informed decision-making.



Prepare and present analysis-based reports to stakeholders, tailoring findings to business needs and audience priorities.



Design, build, and maintain self-service dashboards that enable business teams to access and interpret customer experience insights independently.



Apply statistical analysis techniques to support customer segmentation, audience deep dives, and other advanced analytical needs.



Build and maintain topic models that support business use cases and provide deeper visibility into the end-to-end customer journey.





Required Skills





Experience with Customer Experience measurement principles and techniques (including the use of the NPS and/or CSAT metrics).



Experience with reporting, analysis, and data visualization tools (ex. Tableau, Google Data Studio, Excel).



Demonstrated ability to facilitate discussions, communicate clearly, manage time effectively, and build strong stakeholder relationships.



Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to analyze complex information.



Ability to understand organizational priorities and connect analytical work to business outcomes.



Experience supporting data, reporting, business intelligence, or data warehouse initiatives.





Preferred Skills





Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey tooling



Familiarity with Jira and Confluence



Experience in using AI to capture and/or analyze customer behavior or feedback



Familiarity with web marketing: SEO, AdWords, Social Media tagging, UTM parameters



Data and data formatting: Proficient with multiple data formats: including JSON, XML and CSV.





Qualifications





BA or BS degree in Business, Communications, Information Systems, Data Science, Math or relevant experience



Experience as a CX Analyst, Business Analyst, or related role



Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively

Title: Operations & Analytics Associate
Description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Position Summary

KKR is hiring for an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR's enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.

The Data Operations CoE is seeking to hire an Associate / Senior Analyst to support Analytics efforts across Private Markets and Credit. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders and technology partners to build analytical models, data products, and lightweight tools that go beyond static reporting, translating complex data into clear, actionable insight for investment and operational decision-makers. This is a hands-on role where the candidate should expect to be writing SQL and Python, building and testing models, and developing tools directly.

The ideal candidate would have the unique combination of strong data analysis and data science skills, genuine comfort building tools and applications, and the interpersonal polish to engage confidently with senior leadership. The candidate should have a passion/interest in private markets and credit investing, an interest in embracing new technologies (AI), strong verbal/written communication skills, and be a good cultural fit with an emphasis on collaboration, excellence, and action-oriented results.

Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain analytical models, data products, and lightweight tools that support Private Markets and Credit investment teams, going beyond static reporting to surface original, actionable insight
Serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, gathering requirements, defining analytical use cases, and ensuring delivered solutions meet business needs
Write and optimize complex SQL queries and Python-based scripts to extract, transform, model, and analyze data across multiple sources and platforms, ensuring data quality and consistency
Partner closely with data engineering, technology, and operations teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that underpin analytics, modeling, and tool development
Develop domain expertise in private markets and credit data, including deal, portfolio, fund, and investor data, and apply that knowledge to improve data coverage, quality, and analytical depth
Identify opportunities to streamline manual workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve the efficiency and reliability of data processes across the team
Explore and apply AI tools, large language models, and emerging technologies to build new analytical capabilities and unlock new insight for the business
Collaborate with team members across offices and time zones in support of these initiatives


Qualifications


4+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field, ideally within financial services, private equity, credit, or a comparable institutional environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with demonstrated ability to independently build data models, analytical pipelines, and tools
Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent cloud data warehouse) and BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau) as part of a broader analytical toolkit
Demonstrated ability to work in business-facing roles, translating stakeholder needs into analytical frameworks & tools
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into insight for both technical and non-technical audiences
Intellectual curiosity and interest in private markets, credit, and alternative investments
Strong cultural fit – collaborative, intellectually curious, action-oriented, and committed to high standards of excellence and accountability
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with a proactive, self-starter mindset and high attention to detail


Preferred Qualifications


Direct experience in private markets, credit, or alternative investment data and analytics or background in financial services, asset management, or fintech
Experience building internal applications or tools (e.g., Python-based apps, low-code platforms, or AI-assisted development) to deliver data products beyond dashboards
Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, or large language models to improve business workflows and data processes
Working understanding of dbt for managing data transformations, building modular analytics pipelines, and maintaining well-tested, version-controlled data models
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows

$100,000—$130,000 USD

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 2-3 People To Drive Impact In These Areas


Growth Marketing
Product Development
AI & Automation
Strategic Partnerships


On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here


No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.


What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.


Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.


Who You Are


First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.


What You'll Bring


2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.


Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Title: Lead Success Operations Analyst
Description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo is looking for a Lead Customer Intelligence Analyst to join our growing Customer Insights & Analytics team. In this role, you will partner closely with CX stakeholders and data scientists to design new measurement systems, lead ambiguous analytical investigations, and help build the connected customer-intelligence layer behind Klaviyo's health scoring, personas, and experience-impact work. This role is instrumental in building — not just maintaining — the analytics infrastructure that CX leadership uses to prioritize and measure its biggest initiatives.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building something rather than running an established process.

How You Will Make a Difference


Design and build the Goals Measurement Frameworks & Benchmarks for initiatives and pilots across the CX org - providing a standard way to define, baseline, and track goal attainment across programs.
Lead end-to-end one-off investigations — scoping an ambiguous business question, pulling and analyzing the data, and delivering a decision-ready answer with minimal oversight.
Stand up new dashboards and reporting (journey health, CX theme-and-impact, QBR/MBR inputs, NPS/OKR baselines) and corresponding documentation to allow handoffs to operational reporting teams once stable.
Partner with data scientists on health-score and forecasting work — contributing exploratory analysis, segmentation, and validation to support modeling decisions.
Build reusable data products (Snowflake-backed tools, automated pulls) that let insight delivery scale beyond manual reporting.
Collaborate cross-functionally with CX leadership, data science, and operational reporting teams to keep new builds well-documented and handoff-ready.


Who You Are


5–8 years of experience owning analytical problems end-to-end: from framing the business question, through analysis, to influencing stakeholders and operationalizing the solution.
You have strong, daily-use SQL and Python skills, not just familiarity.
You have a track record of scoping ambiguous problems yourself and driving them to a clear answer, with minimal hand-holding.
You have enough applied statistics/ML literacy to be a credible thought partner to a data scientist, without needing to own the full model lifecycle.
You communicate findings clearly to non-technical and senior stakeholders.
Tableau, Snowflake/Streamlit, customer analytics experience, and prior measurement framework work is a plus.

The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.
