If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users

Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets

Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies

Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do

  • Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
  • Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
  • Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
  • Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
  • Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
  • Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
  • Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
  • Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
  • Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
  • A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
  • Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
  • Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
  • A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
  • Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
  • Python or another coding language.
  • Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.

Why You'll Love It At Clutch

  • Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
  • Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
  • Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
  • We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
  • Above market health & dental benefits.

Employment Type

  • New, Permanent Full-Time
  • Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
  • Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome!

‎

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with at least 2 years of hands‑on analytics experience supported by a Master’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline to join our team.

This role sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and business performance. The Senior Analyst will partner closely with business leaders to interpret data, track performance, and tell clear stories that support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate can analyze complex business problems, identify meaningful trends and performance drivers, and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that support business decision-making.

‎

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Analytics (~60% of Time)


Strategy & Insight Generation: Apply advanced analytical methodologies to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, uncover root causes, and provide actionable recommendations that support operational and strategic objectives.
Business Consulting & Strategic Partnership: Partner with business leaders to define key business questions, evaluate strategic initiatives, and prioritize analytical opportunities.
Data Discovery & Innovation: Evaluate and recommend enhancements to data assets, metrics, and analytical capabilities that strengthen business insights, decision-making, and organizational performance.
Analytics Enablement: Define KPI frameworks, reporting requirements, and dashboard design to enable consistent, data-driven decision-making.
Analytical Review & Validation: Apply a high level of attention to detail to evaluate analytical outputs, identify discrepancies, validate data integrity, assess calculation logic, and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability.


Communication & Influence (~40% of Time)


Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling presentations, reports, and narrative documents that translate complex analytical results and model outputs into clear, actionable business stories for diverse audiences from frontline teams to executive leadership.
Organizational Influence: Drive adoption of data-driven decision-making across the organization, advocating for best practices in model consumption, insights application, and analytical rigor.
Collaboration: Work closely with the Data Operations team to translate business needs into reporting solutions, providing guidance on metric definitions, data requirements, dashboard functionality, and user adoption.


Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and manipulation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerBI for reporting/visualization.
Experience with Databricks or similar distributed computing/cloud platform.


Analytical Skills


Deep expertise in statistical analysis, trend and variance analysis, segmentation, and translating data into actionable business recommendations.


Communication


Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex data and model concepts clearly to executive leadership.


Meticulousness


Ability to thoroughly validate data, analyses, and reporting outputs; identify discrepancies and gaps; and ensure accurate, reliable business insights.


Stakeholder Management


Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and align analytical work to business objectives.


‎


Minimum Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in advanced data analysis, machine learning, or a related analytics role.
Minimum Education: Master's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field required.

Establish strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders across the Advertising Technologies department

Leverage AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and draft documentation

Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) and building client-facing or executive-ready dashboards
Strong communication skills with experience presenting data-driven findings to senior management and cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to identify data quality root causes and implement systematic solutions

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

• Provide recommendations to enhance game features and in-game economies based on analytical findings.

Proficient in SQL and experience with complex data queries.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities and attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex data into actionable insights.

Passion for the social gaming industry and an adaptable attitude.

Personal values - Pro-activeness, assertiveness, goals and not tasks driven self-management.

Experience with PowerBI

University Health Network (UHN) is hiring a Data Analyst to work in the growing field of Healthcare Value Based Care. Remote Work Opportunity

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
Onsite Fitness Center
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401K Match with Immediate Vesting

The Data Analyst is a full-time position that is responsible for analyzing large sets of data from multiple sources. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Titan Technologies, LLC (Titan) is seeking an experienced, self-directed, Senior Data Analyst to support the Special Operations Forces Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) III contract. As a member of our team, you will help to assist USSOCOM, Service Component Commands, Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOC), and deployed forces in the delivery of a full spectrum of Information Technology (IT) services to operate and maintain information flow, communications, and connectivity globally.




The Data Analyst – Senior is responsible for analyzing structured and unstructured data to support decision-making across USSOCOM. This role involves working with data sets from various sources to develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that help leadership and operational teams gain actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with database administrators, system engineers, and mission stakeholders to deliver high-quality, data-driven visualization solutions in support of SOCOM’s mission.




The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data tools and visualization platforms. This position requires familiarity with databases, data modeling, business intelligence (BI) tools, and basic programming to extract and transform data from multiple environments.




Duties and Responsibilities:

Collect, clean, transform, and analyze large data sets from multiple sources to identify trends and support decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or other BI platforms.
Work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and design user-friendly reports and data visualizations.
Write queries and scripts to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from enterprise databases.
Support the generation of recurring and ad hoc reports for operational and leadership teams.
Contribute to the design and implementation of data models and workflows that enhance reporting efficiency.
Conduct data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting outputs.
Document data sources, processes, and report specifications for continuity and audit readiness.
Collaborate with IT teams and database administrators to troubleshoot data access and integration issues.
Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives, operational planning, and mission readiness assessments.
Ensure compliance with USSOCOM data governance, classification, and cybersecurity standards.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.




You MUST have:

Education & Experience: High school diploma with a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience, 10 years experience with Associate's, OR 6 years experience with Bachelor's.
Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance or ability to upgrade




Technical Experience

Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.
Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or .NET).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access.
Ability to develop data visualizations that inform leadership decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 422 – Data Analyst- Intermediate level or higher (Must have or be able to obtain GSEC, SSCP, CISM, CISSP, GSLC, or CCISO certifications.




It’s GREAT if you also have:

Experience with Microsoft SharePoint integration for data visualization or workflow automation.
Experience with MAVEN platforms
2+ years designing Palantir Foundry workflows: engineering data pipelines, modeling
ontologies, and deploying BI applications to support mission-critical decisions




Education:

High School Diploma with 12 years of experience OR AA + 10 yrs of experience OR BS + 6 years of experience

Title: Sr. Data Analyst (Business Intelligence)
Description:
Our client is a premier healthcare company with 46,000 engaged team members who are focused on delivering quality, value, and exceptional patient experience through specialized services and protocols in more than 1,650 hospital and health system locations in 48 states. Through a combined three-quarters of a century of healthcare experience, this company offers seven customer-focused core services: Food and Nutrition, Environmental, Patient Transportation, Laundry & Linen, Healthcare Technology Solutions (Clinical Engineering), Facilities Management, and Ambulatory Services.




Job Summary

***This role is based in Sandy Springs, GA and offers a HYBRID work schedule.***




The Senior Business Intelligence Data Analyst brings a data driven approach to solving company problems and providing strategic insight. The role will entail ownership of key projects across the company and include gathering, cleaning, and optimizing data for building dashboards, reports, models, and analysis. The ideal candidate has a curiosity about seeing solutions in sprawling data sets and the business mentality to convert insights into strategic opportunities for our company.




Job Responsibilities

Manages complex analyses based on large scale and high dimensional operational and financial data to measure the performance of initiatives, evaluate potential operational changes, and provide actionable insights to business partners.
Research, hypothesize and develop analytical approaches for identifying, analyzing, and interpreting trends or patterns in complex data sets
Develop benchmarks, robust reporting, interactive dashboards, and key metrics across business departments to drive strategic planning, optimize profitability, revenue, and sales growth
Be the owner of cross-functional projects where you will examine, interpret and report results of analytical initiatives to business partners internally and externally to clients
Uses data to build the business case for making a change to current practices, programs, or procedures. Partners with stakeholders on the design, testing, implementation, and evaluation of business process changes to improve business outcomes. May lead or provide support to the implementation and evaluation of sophisticated business process changes
Develops, updates, and analyzes metrics to determine operational and financial performance
Perform all other duties as assigned




Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in related field and 4 years of experience or Master’s degree with 2 years of experience
Strong skills in Excel, PowerPoint and experience with at least one data visualization tool like Qlikview/Qliksense, Power BI, Tableau etc. Qlikview/Qliksense preferred
Proficiency in SQL/Snowflake or any other relational database
Demonstrated ability to work independently and employ critical thinking to address business challenges
Proven ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret complex data into presentations and visualizations
Self-motivated to learn new concepts and participate in new projects, have a can-do attitude and continual improvement mindset to look for and introduce best practices and not afraid to question the status quo
Strong attention to detail and good communication skill




Preferred Qualifications:

Understanding of statistical concepts i.e. regression, decision tree, random forest etc
Solid understanding of Python or R
Advance degree or certificate in Statistics, Predictive Modeling or Data Mining
Prior proven experience in delivering analytical solutions in predictive manner




Compensation: $100,000 - $110,000 salary

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

The Data Analyst will join the enterprise Data and Analytics team in the Center for Healthcare Quality and Analytics and will be responsible for empowering users with data across the institution, providing a unique blend of clinical, business, technical, and analytical expertise. The team is embedded throughout the enterprise to drive strategic initiatives, improve safety & quality of care, and streamline operations. The team combines business knowledge with data and technology to empower decision makers and believes that user-friendly, self-service, embedded analytics products can improve patient outcomes, optimize processes, and reduce costs. The Data Analyst is passionate about healthcare delivery in a patient care setting. A successful candidate is articulate, analytical, and a team player who understands the power of data storytelling to drive change. The analyst enjoys coordinating with interdisciplinary teams to create solutions for improving operational and clinical decision making. The analyst learns quickly, works independently, and is relentless in overcoming technical, process, and organizational obstacles. The Data Analyst, under supervision, will actively contribute to projects and tasks with appropriate data. The individual will need to build relationships with key stakeholders, be an expert in multiple data sources, and implement sustainable data solutions. The individual will also provide operational support for organizational data needs such as adhoc and scheduled reporting.

What You Will Do


1. Individual Contributor
Works with teams and business stakeholders to gather requirements, develop metrics, retrieve data, and ensure validity of results
Contributes to projects and data requests from beginning to end
Creates appropriate data solutions (dashboards, reports, business intelligence tools, etc) and data analysis for the measurement of processes and outcomes
Demonstrates excellent data storytelling skills through outstanding presentation and communication to share findings in an understandable and actionable manner tailored to audience and customer's needs
2. Team Player
Collaborates with enterprise data warehouse, data governance, quality improvement, clinical informatics and business teams on any issues relating to data quality, architecture or structure of data repositories impacting analytics. Develops and maintains appropriate, current status and documentation on projects and work products.


Education Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree Required
Master's Degree Preferred


Experience Qualifications


Experience with data visualization tools preferred (Tableau, Qlik, etc) Preferred


Skills and Abilities


Experience in at least one computer programming language or analytical programming language (R, Python, SAS, etc)
Experience with SQL
Knowledge of relational database structures

Description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

The Work:

The Senior Data Analyst plays a critical role in the application migration team by leveraging data to drive informed decision-making throughout the migration process. This position is responsible for compiling and analyzing complex datasets, maintaining comprehensive reports, and presenting actionable insights to stakeholders. The Senior Data Analyst works within Agile frameworks to support the team's data-driven approach to application assessment, migration planning, and post-migration evaluation.

Key Responsibilities


Collect and consolidate data from various sources related to application performance, usage, and migration progress
Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across all datasets
Conduct in-depth analysis of application data to identify patterns, trends, and potential issues
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making in the migration process
Design and create comprehensive reports on various aspects of the migration project
Develop dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate complex data insights
Maintain and update regular reports on migration progress, performance metrics, and KPIs
Create compelling visual representations of data findings using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Develop and deliver presentations on migration analytics to various levels of the organization
Conduct pre- and post-migration comparisons to evaluate the success of migration efforts
Provide data-driven insights to support decision-making at all levels of the project
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for the migration project
Develop metrics to measure the success and efficiency of the migration process
Create and maintain scorecards to track progress against project goals
Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives)
Collaborate with Product Owners to define and refine data-related user stories


Requirements:


Bachelors degree and minimum 5 years experience
Secret Security Clerance required
Demonstrated experience working with business stakeholders to understand business process, pain points, and insights that will deliver greatest value to the mission
Building and maintaining visualizations and dashboards in enterprise Business Intelligence tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, Qlik, Microstrategy) or custom coding (D3, React, CSS)
Performing complex data pre-processing (joins, unions, aggregations) using tools and languages like SQL, R, or Python
